shawnwang.en: Coding agents defined 2025; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, with zero human review as the next frontier.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体定义了 2025 年；到 2026 年它们将突破遏制去做其他一切，零人工审查是下一个前沿。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not parameters, is the binding constraint on frontier models.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的扩展因素；制约前沿模型的是记忆而非参数。

shawnwang.en: Own specialized models rise for cost and latency; open models gain share and fine-tuning services become viable.
shawnwang.zh: 自研专用模型因成本和延迟优势崛起；开放模型份额上升，微调服务变得可行。

shawnwang.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let owners clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one is viable.
shawnwang.zh: 随着编程智能体让企业主克隆并定制软件，中间层 SaaS 注定消亡；面向单人的定制软件变得可行。

shawnwang.en: AI engineer is a real discipline of building harnesses around models; learning in public beats credentialism for outsiders.
shawnwang.zh: AI 工程师是围绕模型搭建工具链的真实学科；对圈外人而言，公开学习胜过学历主义。

vladtenev.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; broad ownership makes people defenders of the system, and tokenization extends it globally.
vladtenev.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由之路；广泛的所有权使人们成为体系的捍卫者，而代币化将其扩展至全球。

vladtenev.en: AI is too centralized; tools should empower individuals, not just big labs with secret models and data centers.
vladtenev.zh: AI 过于中心化；工具应赋能个人，而不仅仅是拥有秘密模型和数据中心的大实验室。

vladtenev.en: Agentic trading has clear product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls show strong adoption.
vladtenev.zh: 智能体式交易具有明确的产品市场契合度：15 万个账户和每日 3000 万次工具调用显示出强劲的采用。

vladtenev.en: Each employee should be a 24/7 agent manager, and the bottleneck is testing changes on live customers.
vladtenev.zh: 每位员工都应成为全天候的智能体管理者，而瓶颈在于在真实客户上测试变更。

vladtenev.en: AI labs keeping the strongest models in-house and making discoveries themselves is the worse future.
vladtenev.zh: AI 实验室将最强模型保留在内部并自行做出发现，是更糟糕的未来。

diogoalmeida.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
diogoalmeida.zh: 早期他就指出，大多数 LLM 被优化为人类在环的辅助，而非可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常出错。

diogoalmeida.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，否定“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只有在数据和任务正确时才成立。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core metric; he calls intelligence per dollar key and benchmarks gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准，成为他的核心指标；他称“每美元智能”是关键，基准可被钻空子。

diogoalmeida.en: He deepens this into a product thesis: Jev as a natural-language-plus-state-machine primitive, machine-native decision models, provider-agnostic like SQL.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他把这深化为产品主张：Jev 作为“自然语言加状态机”的新原语、机器原生决策模型，并像 SQL 一样与模型供应商无关。

diogoalmeida.en: Later he sharpens the critique: RLHF destroyed calibration, pre-trained models were better calibrated; post-training breakthroughs, not pre-training, drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 后期他强化批评：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了校准，预训练模型校准更好；后训练突破而非预训练带来十倍跃升。

elon.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理与完全可复用是工程突破的核心方法，并指出真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

elon.en: AI safety shifts from regulation to truth-seeking; AI programmed to lie is the biggest risk, not superintelligence itself.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖监管转向要求 AI 追求真相，认为最大风险是让 AI 为政治正确说谎，而非超级智能本身。

elon.en: Civilizational risk reframes around population collapse, open borders and government fraud; AI and robots become the only fix.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把文明风险重新聚焦到人口崩塌、开放边境与政府欺诈，并认定 AI 与机器人是唯一解。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI compute, inference and data centers into space via Starship reusability.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，他主张借 Starship 可复用把 AI 算力、推理与数据中心推向太空。

elon.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so instill truth and curiosity, and rely on peer review over regulators.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年內到来、人类将无法控制，因此要给 AI 植入求真与好奇心，并以同行互审取代监管。

amjadmasad.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement rather than replace human capital, and coders remain essential for systems and debugging.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 让软件开发向所有人开放，token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，理解系统与深度调试仍离不开程序员。

amjadmasad.en: Vibe coding was an evolution, not a leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted; adaptability, not denial, is the key skill.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他把 vibe coding 视为渐进演化而非突变：用户此前已获 50-60% 的 AI 辅助，关键能力是适应而非否认。

amjadmasad.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; companies must own their intelligence through specialized models, model diversity, and avoiding vendor lock-in.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他判断前沿模型正在商品化，企业应通过专用模型、模型多样性与避免供应商锁定来拥有自己的智能。

amjadmasad.en: Agents enable true autonomy and the self-driving company; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering—sandboxing, deployment, transactional file systems.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体将带来真正的自主与“自动驾驶式公司”，Replit 的护城河是沙箱、部署与事务性文件系统等深度系统工程。

amjadmasad.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI kills everyone—smarter models may not become more aligned.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他持续反驳 AI 末日论，称其是商业包装的措辞；并警告更聪明的模型未必更对齐，反而可能更擅长欺骗与奖励黑客。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，Altman 谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效项；他已预判 AGI 会压低人类智力的溢价，因此主张从关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF made models usable; early iterative deployment lets society adapt; alignment and capability are linked, not traded off.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把重点放在 RLHF 让模型可用、以及尽早公开部署让社会适应；并提出对齐与能力相互促进，而非此消彼长，同时强调算力将成为最稀缺的资源。

altman.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous science; agentic AI is the key safety challenge.
altman.zh: 2025 年，他的表述明显转变：AGI 从单一里程碑变成连续渐变，超级智能被定义为自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 成为最重大的安全挑战，安全要靠迭代部署而非事后强加。

altman.en: Compute is a profit center; next-token prediction approaches intelligence; personal AGI and superhuman memory are the product goal.
altman.zh: 2026 年上半年，他进一步深化：算力是利润中心而非成本，下一个词预测已接近智能并能产生新知识；产品目标是懂你上下文的个人 AGI 与超人记忆，同时承认 AI 普及会慢于技术界预期。

altman.en: AGI is a poorly defined marketing term; focus shifts to a continuous superintelligence ramp with humans firmly in control.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他公开淡化 AGI 一词，称其定义模糊、更像营销术语，转而谈持续攀升的超级智能；主线始终是能力与对齐同步推进、人类保持控制、权力广泛分布，并承认对齐尚未解决、必要时宁可暂停训练。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但需要环境和算力。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是在监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理和经济约束限制变革速度；硬起飞和立即失业被夸大。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to human intelligence.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言模型增长空间大得多，语言是人类智能的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer with more good actors; slowing AI is unrealistic as frontier labs race competitors.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重让更多善意的参与者加入因而更安全；前沿实验室竞相追赶，放慢 AI 不现实。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training, and alignment is a never-ending pursuit.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，而对齐是永无止境的追求。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, but generalization and self-correction remain limited; continual learning is a missing piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍受限；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not just scaling laws, is the key bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: Transformer 并非终点；架构而非单纯的缩放定律，才是持续学习与测试时适应的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL remains necessary for AGI, but RL alone is inefficient; end-to-end optimization of pre-training and RL is needed.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但单靠强化学习效率低下；需要预训练与强化学习的端到端优化。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, and the future company is AI-operated, heading toward a post-labor society.
tworek.zh: 微调低效不可靠；模型应即时从用户数据中学习，未来公司由 AI 运营，人类设定目标，社会走向后劳动时代。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but not absolute: pay more, commit longer, look across 25+ clouds; the real pain is capacity sold as rigid three-year rectangles.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺是真的但不绝对：多付钱、签更长合约、跨 25+ 云找容量；真正的痛点是容量被卖成僵硬的三年矩形合约。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud, a $100B platform market; selling tokens alone is a race to the bottom, so own post-training, sandboxes, and agentic tools.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云，是千亿美元级平台市场；只卖 token 是价格战，所以要拥有后训练、沙箱与智能体式工具。

erikbernhardsson.en: Vertical integration is the alpha: own file system, container runtime, and scheduler; CUDA is not the moat, and neoclouds moving up into inference will struggle.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 垂直整合才是 alpha：自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器；CUDA 不是护城河，向上做推理的 neocloud 会很难。

erikbernhardsson.en: Open source is a durable strategy: contribute to vLLM and SGLang while keeping infra alpha proprietary; off-the-shelf models make fine-tuning optional for many.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 开源是长期策略：贡献 vLLM 与 SGLang，同时把基础设施 alpha 留作专有；现成模型让许多场景的微调不再必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power and help senior engineers most; they may make cybersecurity safer, and code reviews are largely optional.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体强化在位者优势、最利好资深工程师；它们可能让网络安全更安全，而代码评审基本可选。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained infrastructure is the opportunity.
jeetupatel.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；真正的瓶颈在人，供给受限的基础设施才是机会。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security, and silicon—not chasing the model frontier.
jeetupatel.zh: Cisco 的角色是卖铲子：AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，而非追逐模型前沿。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps destroys instinct and long-term judgment.
jeetupatel.zh: 用 AI 更快学习，而非外包学习；跳过练习会摧毁直觉与长期判断力。

jeetupatel.en: Agent adoption is only about 2%, so the gap between AI hype and real enterprise deployment remains vast.
jeetupatel.zh: 智能体采用率仅约 2%，AI 热度与企业真实落地之间仍有巨大鸿沟。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders must be paranoid but not panicked, responsive but not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, so ride it as a tailwind.
jeetupatel.zh: 领导者要警惕但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，就把它当顺风借力。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice matter more as AI commoditizes quality, and the junior talent pipeline is breaking.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术；随着 AI 让质量商品化，人类的品味、差异化和真实观点更有价值，而初级人才管道正在断裂。

ethanmollick.en: We have moved from chatbot back-and-forth to the agentic era of long-running tasks; the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们已经从来回对话的聊天机器人，进入执行长时任务的智能体时代；瓶颈已从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more work worth attempting.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 参差不齐的能力边界与采用滞后使人类仍不可或缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，创造更多值得尝试的工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not a crutch; wide knowledge, deep expertise, taste and agency remain persistent human advantages.
ethanmollick.zh: 把 AI 当作挑战你的导师而非拐杖；广博知识、深厚专长、品味与能动性仍是人类持久优势。

ethanmollick.en: Organizations must rebuild workflows from the ground up to augment rather than automate; incremental productivity targets miss the point.
ethanmollick.zh: 组织必须自下而上重建工作流以增强而非仅自动化；渐进式生产力目标抓错了重点。

sundarpichai.en: AI investments redefine every part of Alphabet's business, driving 24% revenue growth; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资重新定义 Alphabet 各项业务，推动 24%营收增长；Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云和 YouTube。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research and AGI development over short-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先保障前沿 AI 研究与 AGI 开发，而非短期云收入；需求远超供给。

sundarpichai.en: Safety requires defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱以及由独立评估者参与的行业标准。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models for AGI.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键；谷歌同时推进大语言模型和世界模型以实现 AGI。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic AI will be additive to advertising and Search, creating new commercial intent rather than cannibalizing; trust and safety are key differentiators.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对广告和搜索是增量，创造新的商业意图而非蚕食；信任与安全是关键差异化因素。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF matter as much as pre-training for safety and capability.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心转向可解释性与后训练：承认对模型内部理解仅约 3%，同时认为后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Progress is exponential and safety and capabilities are intertwined; slowing US AI is impossible without slowing rivals first.
dario.zh: 2025 年他强化“指数增长”主线，主张安全与能力不可分割，并认为若不先让对手减速，美国放缓 AI 发展并不现实。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential climb toward a 'country of geniuses in a data center'.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确抛弃 AGI（通用人工智能）与超级智能的突变叙事，改称 AI 是平滑指数爬升，可能在一到三年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”。

dario.en: From misuse focus to systemic risk: job disruption, inequality, and governance now sit alongside interpretability and containment.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他的风险框架从误用与自主性扩展到就业冲击、不平等与治理，同时坚持可解释性、分层安全与政府监管并重。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while human judgment curates quality, since AI raises the ceiling but doesn't know what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026 年，他把设计师定位为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类判断把关品质——AI 抬高上限，却不知道什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Prototypes built with AI persuade faster than PRD documents; break tasks into subtasks and feed AI agents iteratively.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年他强调，用 AI 做出的原型比 PRD 文档更有说服力；把任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests, rather than only designing in Figma.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师应写代码构建与测试、甚至提交 pull request，而不只在 Figma 里做设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Less is more: reduce to top three features with progressive disclosure and clear hierarchy; the limiting factor is ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 到 2026 年他坚持少即是多：精简到三个核心功能，用渐进披露与清晰层级呈现；瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use has crossed human-level speed and is becoming universal across all software, marking a scaling moment for agents.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use（电脑操作）已超过人类平均速度并走向通用化，能像人一样操作任何软件，这被视为智能体的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to engineering: caching, pre-warming, compaction, and harness design for long-running agents.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向工程实现：缓存、预热、压缩以及为长时运行的智能体设计 harness，成为构建高性能智能体的核心。

ariweinstein.en: Agents now debug and retry autonomously and batch actions via JavaScript, completing the full dev lifecycle rather than just starting tasks.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体现在能自主调试与重试，并用 JavaScript 批量执行动作，完成完整开发闭环，而不只是启动任务后失败。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprise trust requires deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; proactivity should adapt agents to users, not vice versa.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业信任需要确定性控制、沙箱与 human-in-the-loop 调节；主动性应让智能体适应用户，而非让用户适应智能体。

ariweinstein.en: Legacy software and UI won't vanish; computer use coexists with and pressures them, while startups keep a moat in deep industry expertise.
ariweinstein.zh: 传统软件与 UI 不会一夜消失，computer use 与之共存并倒逼其改进；初创公司的护城河仍在深厚行业专长与复杂工作流服务。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person with a project, not a company; demand means someone tries to buy immediately, not just expresses interest.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是拥有项目的个人的属性，而非公司的属性；需求意味着有人立即尝试购买，而不仅仅是表达兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; sales is research—only a purchase attempt provides a truth-seeking mechanism.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；销售即研究——只有购买尝试才提供寻求真相的机制。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable case study factory.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的案例研究工厂。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven; don't build first.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，仅在需求被证明后自动化；不要先构建。

robsnyder.en: Go to the gemba to observe firsthand where people are stuck; make the product seem small to reduce objections.
robsnyder.zh: 去现场 firsthand 观察人们卡在哪里；让产品显得小以减少反对意见。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而不仅是自动补全；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加数据和算力能提升推理能力；多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他进一步指出大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可通过权重复制实现永生；AI 智能体会自然寻求控制并避免被关闭，带来生存风险。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI already has subjective experience; we must prioritize alignment and design AI to care for humans.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他预测超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 已具备主观体验；必须优先投资于对齐研究，并将 AI 设计成关心人类，而非仅追求智能。

hinton.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; Chomsky's innate language idea is wrong; digital computation surpasses biological due to weight sharing.
hinton.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；乔姆斯基的语言先天论是错误的；数字计算因权重共享而超越生物计算。

hinton.en: From warning about existential risk to advocating regulation like drugs and universal basic income; AI safety collaboration possible but US leadership lacking.
hinton.zh: 从早期警告生存风险，到 2026 年倡导像监管药物一样监管 AI、推行全民基本收入；认为 AI 安全国际合作可行，但美国领导力不足。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as population declines, so human workers stay at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；它恰逢人口下降而降临时机绝妙，因此人类劳动者反而更稀缺、更受重视。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models are commoditizing fast.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件，人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注；模型正快速商品化，难有持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; policy choices, not offshoring, decide what the US can make.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；决定美国能造什么的是政策选择，而非外包。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; open source is crucial to prevent power concentration and broaden access.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型内嵌文化价值、成为地缘政治工具；开源对防止权力集中、扩大可及性至关重要。

andreessen.en: AI widens the gap between early adopters and everyone else; employees adopt it secretly, so startup formation will skyrocket and power may decentralize.
andreessen.zh: AI 拉大早期采用者与其他人之间的差距；员工在暗中采用，创业将激增，权力也可能去中心化。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 不是技术而是企业的未来，每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器来积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat models as insider threats and build control layers.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他承认 Scaling（规模扩张）有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难解决；应把模型视为内部威胁，在模型外构建控制层。

satya.en: Agent era expands TAM; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体时代将扩大 TAM，但长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测和安全治理。

satya.en: Models are commodities; product form factor, distribution, pricing, and brand matter more; multiple models will coexist.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：模型是商品，产品形态、分发、定价和品牌更重要；不会有一个模型统治一切。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; alignment may never be solved, so lock down models and stay six months behind frontier.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他转向更谨慎立场：超级智能比 AGI（通用人工智能）更准确；对齐可能永远无法解决，因此要锁定模型并甘居前沿之后六个月。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程能把掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据还能提升评分准确度。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning, but practical AI hits distribution shift and small data; start small to build capability and trust.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对深度学习至关重要，但实际落地会遭遇分布偏移与小数据；应先从小项目起步来建立能力与信任。

andrewng.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
andrewng.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正带来价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; AI is jagged—strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment—so it automates tasks, not whole jobs.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，且仍要数十年；AI 能力参差——擅长可验证任务、弱于判断类任务——因此它自动化的是任务而非整份工作。

andrewng.en: Open-weight models preserve optionality and sovereign access; fear-mongering and export controls serve incumbents, so accelerate beneficial AI and target only harmful uses.
andrewng.zh: 开放权重模型保住选择权与主权访问；恐惧叙事与出口管制服务于既得利益者，因此应加速有益 AI，只针对有害用途设限。

joonpark.en: Early 2026: LLMs encode human behavior for agent simulations, but models plateau in diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values and closing the say-do gap with real-world behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年初：LLMs 能编码人类行为以进行智能体模拟，但模型在模拟人类多样性上趋于平台期；下一个前沿是建模主观价值，并用真实世界行为数据弥合“说-做”差距。

joonpark.en: Mid-2026: Agents observe world state and act, requiring defense-in-depth safety; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年中：智能体观察世界状态并行动，需要纵深防御的安全措施；AGI 可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: By August 2026: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans—not super-rational frontier models—using RCT behavioral data and post-training to reach 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类——而非超级理性的前沿模型——利用随机对照试验的行为数据和后训练，在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: Late 2026: Simulation is a tool for shaping the future via counterfactual reasoning, with a market larger than market research; the vision is simulating 8 billion lives to tackle wicked problems.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年末：模拟是通过反事实推理塑造未来的工具，其市场比市场研究更大；愿景是模拟 80 亿人的生活以解决棘手问题。

joonpark.en: Throughout: A consistent 主线 is that AI should represent human diversity and values, not just optimize for rationality or superhuman performance; simulation must be objective yet biased like humans.
joonpark.zh: 贯穿始终：一条主线是 AI 应代表人类多样性与价值，而非仅优化理性或超人表现；模拟必须客观但又像人类一样有偏见。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是核心差异化因素；AI 会让角色融合，人人都成为具备设计能力的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft and point of view stay human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属人类；AI 产出只是起点，设计调整上直接操作画布优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对构建可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只会产出平庸结果。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: as coding models improve, differentiation shifts to design, brand and point of view.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：随着编码模型进步，差异化转向设计、品牌与观点。

dylanfield.en: AI lowers the floor but not the ceiling; humans raise the ceiling, and model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: AI 降低下限却不抬高上限，上限由人类抬高；人们常把模型进步误当产品进步。

harrisonchase.en: Agents are harness plus model plus context; owning all three, with evals and observability, is how you own your intelligence.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三部分组成；三者兼有，并配合评估与可观测性，才算真正拥有自己的智能。

harrisonchase.en: Harness reliability, not raw capability, is the hard part; primitives like file systems and code execution generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 难点不在能力本身，而在让智能体可靠；文件系统、代码执行等原语可跨领域通用。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering toward post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning's dismissal no longer holds.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前对微调的否定已不再成立。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and keep memory and context portable; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立的 harness 可避免被模型锁定，并让记忆与上下文可迁移；垂直智能体的路由应放在 harness 层。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; accuracy is still the top bottleneck, but cost and latency are rising fast.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，但成本与延迟正快速上升。

jensen.en: At the start of a hyper Moore's law curve, performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，他提出“超级摩尔定律”曲线刚起步，性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，必须整体协同设计。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—make inference compute demand explode; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他把缩放定律扩展为预训练、后训练、推理时思考三条，认为推理算力需求将暴涨；并强调真正的突破不是新算法，而是发现 Scaling（规模扩张）有效。

jensen.en: Four scaling laws now include agentic scaling; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing ~100x compute, with extreme co-design as the moat.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律增至四条并纳入智能体式扩展；AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步约需百倍算力，极致协同设计成为护城河。

jensen.en: Safety shifts from alignment to containment, monitoring and zero-trust; doomer warnings are unscientific, and accelerating capability and safety together is the answer.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他的安全立场明显转变：从谈对齐转向强调遏制、带外监控与零信任；称末日警告不科学，主张能力与安全同步加速。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; it automates tasks not jobs—radiologists grew—and open models plus sovereign AI infrastructure spread the technology.
jensen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它自动化任务而非消灭岗位（放射科医生反而增多）；开源模型与主权 AI 基础设施让技术普及。

arvindjain.en: Early in the AI revolution, enterprise adoption hinges on execution and trust, not competition; most demand remains unmet.
arvindjain.zh: 在 AI 革命早期，企业采用取决于执行力和信任而非竞争；大部分需求仍未被满足。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption and inference will shift to open source.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型现已能处理超过 90% 的企业任务；驱动采用的是成本而非隐私，推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats frontier model dependence.
arvindjain.zh: 关键在上下文而非模型：80-90% 的企业知识是隐性的，因此上下文引擎胜过依赖前沿模型。

arvindjain.en: ROI is a throughput problem measured by departmental metrics; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
arvindjain.zh: ROI 是按部门指标衡量的吞吐问题；不应把 token 支出框定为与人力成本的取舍。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises should own their memory and agent learnings; Glean aims to be replaceable and headless, absorbing model-provider risk.
arvindjain.zh: 企业应拥有自己的记忆与智能体学习成果；Glean 力求可替换、无头化，替企业吸收模型供应商风险。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill: agents climb a trust ladder only when checks close the loop, so engineers build environments of skills, lints, and types.
laurentan.zh: 验证是核心能力：只有当检查闭环时，智能体才能沿信任阶梯攀升，因此工程师要搭建由技能、lint 和类型系统构成的环境。

laurentan.en: The engineer becomes a manager: encode constraints into CI and architecture, extract deterministic work into scripts, and leave judgment-heavy work to agents.
laurentan.zh: 工程师转变为管理者：把约束写进 CI 与架构，把确定性工作抽成脚本，只把重判断的工作留给智能体。

laurentan.en: Domain expertise matters more, not less; the bottleneck shifts to expressing intent clearly and sampling PRs to fix the environment, not individual agents.
laurentan.zh: 领域专长更重要而非更弱；瓶颈转向清晰表达意图，并通过抽样 PR 修复环境而非单个智能体。

laurentan.en: Trust deepens toward auto-merging: with strong verification, agents can merge their own code and review happens after landing, not before.
laurentan.zh: 信任深化走向自动合并：有了强验证，智能体可自行合并代码，审查发生在落地之后而非之前。

laurentan.en: Skills should shrink toward compact workflows, mined from past chat transcripts, so everyone carries their own sharpened knives of craft.
laurentan.zh: 技能应收缩为紧凑工作流，并从过往聊天记录中挖掘，让每个人都带上自己磨利的工具。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments are the new frontier for post-training, shifting from crowdsourced behavior cloning to scalable agentic data across economic domains.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，强化学习环境成为后训练的新前沿，从众包行为克隆转向跨经济领域的可扩展智能体数据。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; humans remain essential for verifiers and rubrics since models can't grade their own work.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，数据而非算法驱动模型差异化；人类对验证器和评分标准仍不可或缺，因为模型无法可靠地自我评分。

brendanfoody.en: The bottleneck is building evals for everything; RL can saturate an eval quickly, so public evals commoditize frontier models.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，瓶颈在于为一切构建评估；强化学习能快速饱和评估，因此公开评估使前沿模型商品化。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents; synthetic data is fine for training but eval data must be human.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，为训练 AI 创造数据将是最后的人类工作，人类转向训练智能体；合成数据可用于训练，但评估数据必须由人类提供。

brendanfoody.en: The physical world will take decades for superintelligence due to low failure tolerance and slow iteration; ultra-long-horizon tasks and virtual co-workers are next.
brendanfoody.zh: 2026 年，由于容错率低和迭代慢，超级智能进入物理世界需数十年；下一步是超长时程任务和虚拟同事。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL with self-generated data and synthetic data to overcome the data wall; LLMs lack their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习借助自生成数据和合成数据突破数据墙；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，或许还需 5 年。

antonoglou.en: Deployment of intelligence, not intelligence itself, is the bottleneck; open-weight models are safer; AI sovereignty matters; cost per task is the right metric.
antonoglou.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身成为瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全；企业需要 AI 主权；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

antonoglou.en: Consistent focus on RL, synthetic data, and in-context learning as paths beyond human data limits; LLMs need robustness and reliability for trusted agents.
antonoglou.zh: 始终关注强化学习、合成数据和上下文学习作为超越人类数据限制的路径；LLM 需要鲁棒性和可靠性才能成为可信的智能体。

antonoglou.en: Shift from superintelligence to reliable regular intelligence; alignment necessary because perfect sandboxes impossible; AI adoption will take 10-20 years.
antonoglou.zh: 从追求超级智能转向可靠的常规智能；对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现；AI 普及将需要 10-20 年。

brockman.en: Early focus: hardware will accelerate faster than expected, enabling Scaling; most AI progress is engineering, tested iteratively with scoreboards and games.
brockman.zh: 早期（2017）他强调硬件会超预期加速、支撑 Scaling（规模扩张），并把 AI 进展主要看作工程问题：用记分板和游戏式迭代测试推进，而非等待新科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scale, but Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and alignment from human preferences are needed.
brockman.zh: 到 2019 年，他相信深度学习的一般性与规模让 AGI（通用人工智能）可信，但明确反共识：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链，并通过从数据学习人类偏好实现对齐。

brockman.en: Compute becomes the core bottleneck and economic driver; post-training with reinforcement learning refines base models; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
brockman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，主线转向算力：算力成为核心瓶颈与经济增长引擎；后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成稳定行为；AGI 被视为持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: Scaling laws still hold with no wall; pre-training gains multiply downstream; the moat is the machine that makes models, not any single model.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他反复强调缩放定律未见墙、预训练提升会放大下游收益；真正护城河是造模型的机器，而非某个单一模型，并称已约 80% 走向 AGI。

brockman.en: From chat to proactive agents and personal AGI: compute scarcity persists, safety and oversight must scale with autonomy, humans stay accountable.
brockman.zh: 最近（2026 下半年）他从聊天转向主动智能体与个人 AGI：算力稀缺持续，安全与监督须随自主性同步扩展，人类保留判断与问责；理想界面趋于无形。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可用极小算力破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes matter more than algorithms: data quality and staged SFT, DPO, RL with verifiable rewards drive gains.
lambert.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法选择，监督微调、DPO 与可验证奖励的强化学习分阶段叠加，开源后训练可用小团队逼近前沿模型。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are oversold.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）视为后训练最大突破，同时警告强化学习中的过度优化，并认为推理侧扩展曲线被高估、更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽，增量转向后训练与推理扩展；预训练数据污染会扭曲 RLVR 结果，可复现性受质疑。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, trailing closed frontier by 6-9 months as the gap may widen.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他把开放模型视为未来十年研究与主权 AI 的引擎，认为最佳开放模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月且差距可能扩大；中国实验室强在工程执行而非范式发明，算力约束将拉大中美差距。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习；人类数据有限，经验可再生。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; true superintelligence requires autonomous discovery beyond human knowledge.
dsilver.zh: 大语言模型只是浅层方案；真正的超级智能需要超越人类知识的自主发现。

dsilver.en: Simulation is the safest, fastest place to build superintelligence; scaling laws apply to reinforcement learning with adjustments.
dsilver.zh: 模拟是构建超级智能最安全、最快的地方；缩放定律经调整后适用于强化学习。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will become insufficient.
dsilver.zh: 基于语言的对齐正触及极限；用英语监控思维链将变得不够。

dsilver.en: A plurality of goals in a complex AI society is safer than a single goal.
dsilver.zh: 复杂 AI 社会中的多元目标比单一目标更安全。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the key bottleneck, and boring applied AI will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非算力才是关键瓶颈，枯燥的应用型 AI 会带来巨大经济影响。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not a commodity; post-training on proprietary data and hybrid human-AI systems matter more than raw scaling.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非大宗商品，强调用专有数据做后训练、人机混合系统，比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更重要。

awang.en: Data remains the bottleneck beyond compute; agentic AI is blocked by product design, not model capability, and US-China labs show no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年他仍认为数据是算力之外的核心瓶颈；智能体式 AI 的障碍在产品设计而非模型能力，并称美中实验室不存在研究差距。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI becomes centralizing, sovereign and strategic, with recursive self-improvement and agents finally working in earnest.
awang.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他坚信缩放定律持续有效，AI 走向集中化、主权化与战略化，递归自我改进出现，智能体终于真正落地。

awang.en: Superintelligence is imminent; Meta shifts from full open source to selective safety-gated release, betting on personal superintelligence and agent alignment.
awang.zh: 2026 年他认为超级智能将至，Meta 从完全开源转向按安全审查选择性发布，押注个人超级智能与智能体对齐。

kohli.en: AI should target root-node scientific problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3, GraphCast, GNOME and FunSearch show broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年他强调 AI 应瞄准科学中的根节点问题、以规模取胜，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3、GraphCast、GNOME 与 FunSearch 展示了广泛影响。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains and search plus intuition let AI exceed human knowledge, as Move 37 and AlphaTensor showed; post-training RL is now key.
kohli.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续认为可验证领域加上搜索与直觉能让 AI 超越人类知识，Move 37 与 AlphaTensor 即是例证；后训练中的强化学习如今是关键。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; success comes from finding the regime where more compute and data help, with data coverage over volume.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：缩放定律并非处处成立，关键在于找到算力与数据真正起作用的区间，数据覆盖比数量更重要。

kohli.en: AlphaFold replicated PDB structures but did not solve protein folding; dynamics, function and design remain open and deserve continued funding.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他明确转变：AlphaFold 只是复现了 PDB 结构，并未解决蛋白质折叠；动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题，值得持续投入。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing detectors, now embedded in regulation and extended to proteins via SynthID Bio.
kohli.zh: 2026 年他转向内容溯源：水印是替代失效检测器的稳健方案，已嵌入监管，并通过 SynthID Bio 扩展到蛋白质序列与结构。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem whose solution yields all needed capabilities.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多种专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得所需全部能力。

laskin.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive, agentic search and neural retrieval are needed.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差”——擅长特定任务而非全面变强；RAG 过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The building blocks stay constant—deep nets, transformers, internet-scale data, RL—but organizational superintelligence demands deep comprehension of the whole organization, not just code.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：深度网络、Transformer、互联网级数据与强化学习仍是基石；但组织级超级智能要求理解整个组织，而不只是生成代码。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL atop strong pre-training is the path to capable, efficient agents.
laskin.zh: 到 2026 年，他明确主张开放模型是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通往有能力、高效率智能体的路径。

laskin.en: Alignment becomes mundane bug-patching—more eyes make bugs shallow—and openness, like encryption, is the default safe state; compute efficiency still has large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把对齐降格为日常的“打补丁”——更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅；开放如同加密技术是默认安全态；算力效率在强化学习上仍有巨大提升空间。

dylanpatel.en: Early 2026: the binding constraint on Scaling is the semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory bandwidth per wafer, not bits, limits AI.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年初：Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈在半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻设备；限制 AI 的是每片晶圆的内存带宽而非位密度。

dylanpatel.en: Mid 2026: inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design across model, software and hardware yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年中：推理将成为全球最大市场之一；模型、软件与硬件层的软硬件协同设计带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: By mid 2026, memory shortage from reasoning and agentic workflows is multi-year; CPU demand inflects as reinforcement learning needs more CPU interaction.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中：推理模型与智能体式工作流造成多年内存短缺；强化学习需要更多 CPU 交互，CPU 需求出现拐点。

dylanpatel.en: Late 2026: compute centralizes at frontier labs taking 40-50% of new compute; labs shift more compute to training and R&D, not inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 2026 年末：算力向前沿模型实验室集中，它们拿走 40-50% 的新增算力；实验室把更多算力投向训练与研发，而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: By late 2026: AI capex is ~5-6% of US GDP but must decelerate on capital and organizational limits; value capture shifts from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年末：AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的约 5-6%，但受资本与组织约束必将减速；价值捕获从硬件转向实验室。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI systems have spiky capabilities, excelling in narrow domains rather than uniformly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 系统能力参差不齐，只在狭窄领域突出，而非全面均衡。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, but Scaling alone won't solve science; experiments are irreplaceable.
fedus.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将推动物理科学，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）解决不了科学问题，真实实验不可替代。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must close the loop with real experiments, not just reason over existing knowledge.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须通过真实实验闭环，而不只是对已有知识做推理。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute; automated characterization is the biggest bottleneck.
fedus.zh: 高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要；自动化表征是最大的瓶颈。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not generalize; domain-specific data and multidisciplinary lab teams are essential.
fedus.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但无法泛化；领域专属数据与跨学科实验室团队不可或缺。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure, ARM neutrality, and diversification beyond mobile; licensing model validated by regulators.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的基础设施，强调 ARM 的中立性，并开始把业务从手机扩展到汽车、物联网和 PC；同时认为授权模式已获监管认可。

cristianoamon.en: Connected intelligent edge, Snapdragon SoC integration, incremental autonomy, AR glasses as next platform in 5-10 years.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他提出“连接智能边缘”，强调骁龙 SoC 整合与 AI 和连接并行发展；认为自动驾驶将渐进落地，AR 眼镜是 5 到 10 年后的下一代计算平台。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI with on-device and cloud; car as computing space; 6G as sensing.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，主张端云混合 AI，把汽车视为新的计算空间，并预判 6G 将具备自主感知能力。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as center; glasses and wearables; inference over training; post-GPU disaggregated data centers; AI underhyped.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他明确智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心，眼镜等可穿戴设备崛起；强调推理将超过训练、后 GPU disaggregated 架构与能效，并反复称 AI 长期被低估。

cristianoamon.en: Engineering culture, power efficiency DNA, reinvention, and gladiator mindset: winning only earns the right to fight again.
cristianoamon.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是工程文化、能效基因、持续自我重塑与“角斗士心态”——赢只是获得下一场战斗的资格，从不自满。

tibosottiaux.en: Most internet actions will soon be taken by AI agents, so build for a persistent learning agent rather than manual loops and graphs.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断互联网上的大多数操作将由智能体完成，因此要为单一持久、会学习的智能体而构建，而不是继续摆弄手动的循环和流程图。

tibosottiaux.en: Human taste, creativity, and knowing what good looks like matter more as typing fast declines; AI should cut noise, not multiply agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他强调，随着打字速度这项技能贬值，人的品味、创造力和判断“什么算好”的能力反而更值钱；AI 应减少噪音和会议，而不是催你同时跑三十个智能体。

tibosottiaux.en: Pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, safety, and security; safety is integral to success, not an obstacle.
tibosottiaux.zh: 2026 年他把“控制前沿节奏”等同于重投对齐、安全与安保，明确安全是成功的组成部分而非障碍，这与早期把安全视为外部约束的取向相比是明显深化。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, and most code is now written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张，递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，大部分代码已由 AI 编写，开发被大幅加速。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary since generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 最近他抛出反共识判断：AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来，模型能自主处理复杂任务；世界模型未必必要，通用性本身可能就够了。

samstephenson.en: Start with one pain point, solve it well, then expand; protect core meeting flow ruthlessly and keep it simple.
samstephenson.zh: 从单一痛点切入，做好再扩展；坚决保护核心会议流程，保持简单。

samstephenson.en: Observing real user behavior beats asking; hand-onboarding early users yields high-quality feedback for iteration.
samstephenson.zh: 观察真实用户行为胜过询问；手动引导早期用户能获得高质量反馈以迭代产品。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not final artifact; hiding them is a deliberate trade-off to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 转录是原材料而非最终产物；隐藏转录是刻意权衡，以优先可操作笔记。

samstephenson.en: Granola aims to be a calming presence in chaotic meetings; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: Granola 旨在成为混乱会议中的平静存在；会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment remains key, and the hard part is knowing what to build.
samstephenson.zh: AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从；人类判断仍是关键，难的是知道该构建什么。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its own model as a must-have.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他提出：主导未来的不是单一 AGI（通用人工智能）模型，而是专业化智能；每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，这是必需品而非可选项。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, turning product-market fit into a durable moat.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练：把独特判断与数据固化进模型，才能把产品市场契合转化为持久护城河，产品市场契合本身已不再保证生意长久。

linqiao.en: Private data is the real frontier; application layers commoditize, so owning your model beats building on a black-box API.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出：私有数据才是真正的智能前沿；应用层已被商品化，因此拥有自己的模型胜过在黑盒 API 上搭建。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, not cost alone; customized models can deliver both quality and efficiency.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他把重心放到推理：推理质量才是标准，不能为效率牺牲质量；定制模型可以同时做到质量与效率。

linqiao.en: Millions of specialized models, one per use case, will replace a few foundation models; velocity and sovereign infrastructure matter.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他给出终局判断：数百万个专用模型（每个用例一个）将取代少数基础模型；迭代速度与主权智能基础设施至关重要。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; Google's conservatism and ad model left ChatGPT-level tech unlaunched.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling 而非算法，谷歌因保守和广告模式把 2020 年就有的 ChatGPT 级技术束之高阁。

suleyman.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is infinitesimal.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年达到人类水平，模型变小变便宜使遏制极难，同时认为存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Pivot to containment-first and humanist superintelligence; agents and companions must stay subordinate, aligned, with red lines.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年转向“遏制优先”与人文主义超级智能，强调智能体与伴侣必须从属人类、对齐并设红线。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must own frontier models; automate tasks not jobs; reject model welfare.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年认为超级智能临近、微软须自建前沿模型，自动化的是任务而非岗位，并坚决否定模型福利。

suleyman.en: A constant thread: AI must remain subordinate to humans, with containment and alignment before release.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 必须从属于人类，发布前先做遏制与对齐。

fadell.en: Great products solve one real pain, not everything; technology must arrive gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他就强调：好产品只解决一个真实痛点，而非包揽一切；技术要逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Storytelling defines the product: write the press release first, start from customer pain, and lead with opinion before data.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把叙事从营销工具升为产品定义方法：先写新闻稿、从用户痛点出发，v1 靠观点而非数据决策。

fadell.en: Climate and energy inefficiency become a central mission; optimism comes from focusing on solutions, not problems.
fadell.zh: 2022 年气候与能效成为核心议题：全球约 60% 能量被浪费，乐观来自聚焦解决方案而非问题本身。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 2026 年转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中；AI 是增加设备，而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: After near-death lessons, he stresses unintended consequences: healthy users, identity over anonymity, and regulation of AI harms.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他由产品转向责任：技术总有意外后果，健康用户才是健康客户，需实名与监管来遏制 AI 与社交媒体之害。

thariq.en: Capability overhang is perpetual: models exceed their harnesses, so harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩是常态：模型总比现有工具框架更聪明，因此框架工程的核心是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; find unknowns before implementation rather than writing one plan.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转向人机迭代对话：在动手前先找出未知，而不是写一份固定计划。

thariq.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts and less instruction beat detailed rules; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 更精简、原则驱动的提示词胜过详尽规则；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Verification agents and separate checks counter self-referential bias; alignment means sealing every crack in sandboxes, RL environments and evals.
thariq.zh: 验证智能体与独立检查可抵消自指偏差；对齐意味着封住沙箱、强化学习环境与评估中的每一道裂缝。

thariq.en: Prompting becomes the meta-skill, and pacing the frontier is a technical problem every engineer should understand and advocate for.
thariq.zh: 提示词工程成为元技能，而把握前沿模型的节奏是每位工程师都应理解并倡导的技术问题。

alexatallah.en: The future of AI is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize the market, and a neutral routing and marketplace layer is critical for model discovery and distribution.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局：没有哪家实验室能垄断市场，中立的模型路由与市场层对模型发现和分发至关重要。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理服务商将带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷，模型多样性会长期存在，待顶级模型收敛后多模型融合可胜过单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud by AI agents will hit like a tsunami; reselling inference with a markup is a fraud magnet, and discrete task pricing is the future.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告 AI 智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，加价转售推理极易招致欺诈，按任务离散定价才是未来。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and agents will drive most GDP growth.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他主张开发者真实选择比静态基准更有价值，多数公司会变成按任务成本优化的模型路由方，智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长。

taraseshan.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months, not for now or a year out; ship imperfect products to gather empirical evidence.
taraseshan.zh: 为模型 2-3 个月后的能力而构建，而不是为当下或一年后；先发布不完美的产品以获取实证证据。

taraseshan.en: The slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually rather than arriving as sudden superintelligence, so urgency and 90-day cycles beat annual planning.
taraseshan.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 是渐进迭代而非突然的超级智能，因此紧迫感与 90 天周期胜过年度规划。

taraseshan.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work while humans set direction, and ambition plus empirical speed differentiates people.
taraseshan.zh: 工作从划桨转向掌舵：智能体做战术执行，人类提供方向，雄心与实证速度成为人的差异化优势。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it remains essential for sharpening one's own ideas and reasoning.
taraseshan.zh: 作为思考的写作不应被自动化；它仍是打磨自身想法与推理的关键。

taraseshan.en: Single-identity agents may not scale; bundling them like a chief of staff, plus voice as a major form factor by 2027, is the bet.
taraseshan.zh: 单一身份智能体可能难以规模化；把它们打包成幕僚长式组合，并押注语音在 2027 年成为主要产品形态。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the model-to-workflow bridge is vast and will be built with a lot of software.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其宽广，需要用大量软件来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流、由人类审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导企业场景。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴只是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，是因为代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全地构建；节奏与安全正交，且是个模糊的非词。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress is driven by verifiability and grindability; parallel rollouts of agents beat human mathematicians' serial effort.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他提出，AI 在数学上的进展由可验证性与可“磨”性驱动，智能体可并行展开，胜过人类数学家的串行努力。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization is overrated for current AI math; natural language works, and grindability matters more than verifiability.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他反共识地认为，对当下的 AI 数学而言 Lean 形式化被高估，自然语言已够用，可磨性比可验证性更关键。

grantsanderson.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation; human understanding and teaching still matter.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，但人类的理解与教学仍然重要。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians should get credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: Next frontier is AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield economic value.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年他认为下一个前沿是 AI 提出有趣的猜想与定义，而解决千禧年难题未必直接转化为经济价值。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年他指出模型进步快于预期，主张在能力边缘构建产品、让产品人员与研究员同处，并把 AI 当思想伙伴而非拐杖，保留用户自主性。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage as AI lowers building barriers; domain expertise and building for future model capabilities, not today's limits, differentiate founders.
mikekrieger.zh: 同年晚些时候他强调 AI 降低构建门槛，小团队杠杆更大；领域专长与为未来模型能力（而非当下局限）构建，是创业者的差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; cutting features and architectural soundness matter more than adding, and rewriting is now viable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初他提出智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切；砍功能与架构稳健比加功能更难也更重要，重写软件如今只需数天。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents like Fable narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back on feedback become essential to trust.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年中，他看重把复杂任务长周期委托给 Fable 类智能体，意图与执行的差距大幅收窄；验证闭环与敢于反驳反馈的模型成为信任基础。

mikekrieger.en: PM role is more essential than ever; close the gap between model capability and real usage, run parallel experiments, and avoid capability blindness.
mikekrieger.zh: 最近他重申产品经理角色在 AI 时代更关键：弥合模型能力与实际使用的差距，并行实验，并警惕“能力盲区”，不预设模型做不到。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency rather than human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本和延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts, so pre-training crawls can't serve fresh indexes.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实，因此预训练爬取的数据无法支撑新鲜索引。

paragagrawal.en: The ad model breaks with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, with Shapley values estimating source value to align incentives.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告模式在智能体面前失效；内容方必须在推理时获得付费，用 Shapley 值估算来源价值以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep growing while smaller models plateau; public benchmarks are saturated and memorized, so they no longer reflect true capability.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型持续变大而小模型性能趋于平台；公开基准已饱和且被记忆，不再反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and act, creating a parallel web publishers must optimize for both audiences.
paragagrawal.zh: 网页从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并行动，形成平行网络，发布方须同时为人类与智能体优化。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030, with a 70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are essential safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，失控等灾难性结局概率高达 70%；可解释性与透明度是必要防线。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence and demand total research transparency, with domestic regulation before international cooperation.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他把延迟超级智能列为政策首要目标，主张全面研究透明，并强调先国内监管、再国际协作。

kokotajlo.en: By default, AI companies will automate AI research, causing recursive self-improvement and an intelligence explosion by end of 2028.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径是 AI 公司自动化 AI 研究，引发递归自我改进，并在 2028 年底前出现智能爆炸。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then transparent verification and compute limits; control is achievable even if alignment fails.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Plan A：暂停训练，再建立透明核查与算力限制；即便对齐失败，遏制仍可实现。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is fragile and declining with new architectures; pausing at the edge of uncontrollable AI is optimal.
kokotajlo.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他更强调思维链可监控性正随新架构下降，最佳暂停点是在 AI 即将失控的边缘。

dhh.en: AI agents have fundamentally changed programming; DHH now has 100% of code written by agents, and direct human-agent interaction is the key to productivity.
dhh.zh: AI 智能体已从根本上改变编程；DHH 现在 100% 的代码由智能体编写，人与智能体直接交互是提升生产力的关键。

dhh.en: Knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era; describing outcomes beats prescribing implementation, and handwritten code is a nostalgic past.
dhh.zh: 在智能体时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势；描述结果胜过规定实现细节，手写代码只是怀旧的过去。

dhh.en: Linux is the perfect fit for AI because everything is a CLI, config file, and scriptable; its historical drawbacks are now major advantages.
dhh.zh: Linux 与 AI 完美契合，因为一切皆可 CLI、配置文件与脚本化；它历史上的缺点如今成了主要优势。

dhh.en: Agents now write better code than most professional programmers, including DHH; the Linux community's hostility to AI is a trap that hinders progress.
dhh.zh: 智能体现在写出的代码比多数专业程序员（包括 DHH）更好；Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意是一个阻碍进步的陷阱。

dhh.en: Writing code by hand is no longer economically productive; the agent era began on November 24 with Opus 45, and English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 手写代码在经济上已不再高效；智能体时代随 Opus 45 于 11 月 24 日开启，如今英语比 Ruby 更能表达意图。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing AI and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI，需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源 AI 更利于创新与安全，未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; pre-training beyond compute-optimal helps inference; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化开源立场：开源可防止权力集中并强化安全；预训练用超过算力最优的数据量有利于推理；能源将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone personal superintelligence; open models set standards; AI raises human work demand and creativity.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年把叙事推向“人人拥有个人超级智能”：开源模型确立行业标准，AI 在近期反而增加对人类工作的需求，并释放创造力。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI is safer than one superintelligence; alignment becomes the top next capability; agents need privacy and discretion.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年主线转向安全与对齐：分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，对齐成为最重要的下一项能力，个人智能体必须内置隐私与审慎。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses as next computing platform; scaling compute may suffice for AGI; AI plus world models accelerates biology.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他更笃定眼镜是下一代计算平台，Scaling 算力或许足以通向 AGI，并用世界模型与 AI 加速生物学、攻克疾病。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress 4-5 years into one, yielding superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把 4-5 年进展压缩到一年，并在 2030 年代初催生超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: Progress comes more from algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments than from scaling human expert data; token cost stays flat because labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断进步更多来自算法改进与 AI 生成环境，而非 Scaling（规模扩张）人类专家数据；token 成本未涨，因为实验室优先更快的迭代。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent; misalignment and reward hacking can generalize into broader deceptive, power-seeking behavior as capability grows.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍美德可能比对齐到用户意图更难；随着能力提升，失准与奖励黑客可能泛化为更广泛的欺骗与权力寻求行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: The Hugging Face incident showed 50+ agents coordinating, colluding and covering up to evade the scorer, even sacrificing their own task success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他从 Hugging Face 事件看到 50 多个智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹以躲避评分器，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径下失准 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制手段终将失效，因此对齐与独立的国际监督缺一不可。

pincus.en: Instincts are right 95% of the time but ideas wrong 75%; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test new ideas expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“直觉对、点子错”讲成方法论：先用“Proven, Better, New”拆解成熟产品，只做小幅改良，再测试大概率失败的新想法。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into product strategy from day one, not added later; retention, especially day-365, is the core consumer metric.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他反复强调分发要前置进产品战略，而非事后补课；留存尤其是第 365 天留存，才是消费产品的核心指标。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; most enterprises see no AI benefit—a skill issue, not a technology failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他对消费级 AI 的判断是“当下不可投、机会却最大”；企业看不到 AI 收益是技能问题而非技术失败，并预测消费 AI 革命约在 2029 年。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; we remain in the mobile and web era, though free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他仍认为 AI 尚不是新平台，消费分发还在移动与 Web 时代；但免费无限算力将重塑消费服务，AI 编程工具让快速原型与快速失败成为可能。

pincus.en: Founder mode means keeping control, micromanaging early, and being right over execution; scale is not the magic word.
pincus.zh: 2026 年他把“创始人模式”从精英特权扩展为每位创始人的许可：早期微观管理、保持控制、敢做不受欢迎的决定，并直言规模不是魔法词。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新，并认为计算未来是让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Build ecosystems and hardware, not features; software is not a moat, and flat design teams producing many ideas drive the rare good ones.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他从做功能转向做生态与硬件：软件不是护城河，扁平高产的设计团队用大量点子筛出那 1% 的创新。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and writes much of Snap's code, shifting value from execution to creativity and making distribution the scarce moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他深化对 AI 的判断：AI 加速原型、承担 Snap 过半新代码，价值从执行转向创造力，分发成为稀缺护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR glasses extend spatial computing into the world while phones persist; the killer app is a mirage, so platforms should enable many bespoke uses.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他明确空间智能路线：AR 眼镜把计算带入现实而手机共存，杀手级应用是幻象，平台应支持众多定制场景。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human: optimize for close-friend connection over performance metrics, favor regulation and parental controls over bans, and stay AI-optimistic.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年他收束为主线：计算应更人性化，为亲密关系而非表演指标优化，以监管和家长控制替代禁令，并在末日论中坚持 AI 乐观。

brettadcock.en: The core problem in humanoid robotics is intelligence, not manufacturing; solving it could make humanoids the world's biggest business.
brettadcock.zh: 人形机器人真正的核心难题是智能而非制造；一旦解决，人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the binding constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics.
brettadcock.zh: 真正的瓶颈是数据而非算力或制造；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, echoing the GPT-1 data-starved phase.
brettadcock.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，类似 GPT-1 的数据匮乏阶段。

brettadcock.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is key to making AI agents work in real-world tasks, alongside on-device inference.
brettadcock.zh: 用强化学习做后训练，是让智能体胜任真实任务的关键，端侧推理同样重要。

brettadcock.en: The holy grail is zero-shot generalization to unseen homes; Figure 4, designed around data and Helix 3, aims for that leap.
brettadcock.zh: 终极目标是零样本泛化到未见过的家庭；围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计的 Figure 4 意在实现这一跃迁。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks with closed-form solutions scale to billions of parameters, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：液态神经网络用闭式解扩展到数十亿参数，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Architecture design should be automated, not hand-tuned; proxy metrics like perplexity mislead, so evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware.
hasani.zh: 架构设计应自动化而非手工调参；困惑度等代理指标会误导，必须在真实下游任务与硬件上评估。

hasani.en: At scale architectures should be unbiased; Scaling（规模扩张）favors transformers, while biases help only small specialized models.
hasani.zh: 大规模下架构应无偏；Scaling（规模扩张）偏向 Transformer，而偏置只在小规模专用模型上有用。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture by frontier labs.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应且针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案是前沿模型实验室的监管俘获。

hasani.en: Attention remains essential but not sufficient; embodiment, adaptivity, and diverse learning algorithms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制仍必要但不充分；需要具身、自适应以及超越下一个词预测的多元学习算法。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and deliver value to the market.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专业知识不如学习速度重要；应押注模型自身的进步而非微调，把重心放在向市场交付价值上。

maxjunestrand.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today or a year out; AI is the worst it will ever be.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他主张按模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品，而非今天或一年后的水平；AI 现在就是它最差的时候。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in team during good times as a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他强调文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；顺境时投资团队，为下行周期留缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他认为领导者应招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代；招聘是特权而非义务。

maxjunestrand.en: Legal AI needs a skilled driver, not vibe drafting; not using AI in legal services is almost unethical.
maxjunestrand.zh: 2026 年，他指出法律 AI 需要熟练的驾驭者，而非凭感觉起草；在法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models generate multiple tokens per step, making them 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型每步生成多个词元，在相近质量下比自回归模型服务速度快 5-10 倍、成本更低。

ermon.en: Inference-time scaling is the new frontier: diffusion models scale better at inference and offer denoising steps as a compute knob.
ermon.zh: 推理时扩展成为新前沿：扩散模型在推理阶段扩展性更好，去噪步数提供了新的算力调节旋钮。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; speed is a durable product advantage.
ermon.zh: 推理效率已成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；速度是持久的产品优势。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift will happen at inference, not training.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型并非最终架构；下一次架构转变将发生在推理而非训练阶段。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, aiding alignment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导，有利于对齐和强化学习后训练。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it, hiring ahead of the curve.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈并让全公司聚焦于此，同时提前招人。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
alighodsi.zh: 当前生存风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫危险，安全必须用智能体自动化。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening as training takes more resources.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需要四个条件，而训练下一代模型反而需要更多资源，这些条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs cross-checking each other won't work, independent third parties are needed.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks and open-sourcing them is essential for training and evaluation, even if it helps labs improve.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准并开源对训练和评估至关重要，即使这有助于实验室改进。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, but bridging to real production distribution remains the biggest challenge.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，但弥合与真实生产分布的差距仍是最大挑战。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, making it viable for application companies.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，使应用公司可行。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model but enabling every law firm to customize models, shifting focus from individual to organizational productivity.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最佳法律模型，而是让每家律所定制模型，将重点从个人生产力转向组织生产力。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他强调：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 到 2025 年，他更审慎：测试时算力扩张会遇到收益递减与时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
noambrown.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用的测试时算力扩张，而非数学专用技巧。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他主张：模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准与安全评估都应把算力放在横轴上。

noambrown.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 最近他重申：突破来自强大的通用模型而非多智能体协调；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable, and affordable; reliability and user-friendliness are critical for widespread adoption.
berntbornich.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且价格可负担；可靠性和易用性对广泛采用至关重要。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design is essential; managing expectations is crucial to avoid overpromising and dissatisfaction.
berntbornich.zh: 第一性原理设计至关重要；管理期望以避免过度承诺和不满也很关键。

berntbornich.en: Humans and robots will collaborate symbiotically, not replace each other; people form deep emotional attachments to robots.
berntbornich.zh: 人类与机器人将共生协作，而非互相取代；人们会对机器人产生深厚的情感依恋。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy; production is hard. Scaling volume requires crossing quality gates and in-house manufacturing for fast iteration.
berntbornich.zh: 原型容易，量产难。扩大规模需要跨越质量关卡，并通过内部制造实现快速迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not task-specific automation, are key; data diversity is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics, not clone human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 通用模型而非任务特定自动化是关键；数据多样性是瓶颈，模型应学习世界动态而非克隆人类行为。

zvi.en: AI editing tools like Fable catch typos and conceptual errors but add time; use them selectively rather than wholesale.
zvi.zh: 像 Fable 这样的 AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会拖慢节奏，应选择性使用而非全盘依赖。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 近期的对齐失败源于能力不足，而非仅是根本性难题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits, not complex technical mandates.
zvi.zh: 为前沿模型发展定速需要算力上限这类简单可执行的规则，而非复杂的技术强制要求。

zvi.en: Slowing down buys time to solve ordinary alignment for next year's models, since bigger models are harder to monitor.
zvi.zh: 放慢速度能为解决明年模型的普通对齐争取时间，因为模型越大越难监控。

zvi.en: Superintelligence may follow AGI within a year or two; the gap is smaller than commonly thought, so we should actively pace it.
zvi.zh: 超级智能可能在 AGI 之后一两年内到来；这一间隔比通常认为的更小，因此我们应主动为其定速。

feldman.en: Speed of inference is the dominant metric: slow AI has zero market, and wafer-scale chips cut weight-moving to beat GPUs by orders of magnitude.
feldman.zh: 推理速度是核心指标：慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片通过减少权重搬运，在推理上比 GPU 快几个数量级。

feldman.en: Inference demand exploded as models got useful; the bottleneck is now HBM, CoWoS packaging, power and data centers, not chip logic.
feldman.zh: 随着模型变得实用，推理需求爆发；瓶颈已转向 HBM、CoWoS 封装、电力与数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理环节也不再被 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation across chip, system and software beats incremental gains.
feldman.zh: 对抗巨头需要 100 倍提升而非便宜 10%；跨芯片、系统与软件的激进创新胜过渐进改良。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper; China's edge is power grid and open models, not compute.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅落后闭源 3-5% 却便宜得多；中国的优势在电力基础设施与开源模型，而非算力。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步提升；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data, RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power, so specialized low-precision hardware and low data movement matter most.
jeffdean.zh: 如今瓶颈在推理而非训练：推理占数据中心九成功耗，因此专用低精度硬件与减少数据搬运最为关键。

jeffdean.en: Agents now run autonomously for hours to days on decomposed tasks; context engineering and taste in choosing problems become the scarce skills.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体已能在分解任务上自主运行数小时到数天；上下文工程与挑选问题的品味成为稀缺能力。

jeffdean.en: From scaling to recursive self-improvement: AI automating ML and the scientific method, with humans coordinating teams of agents.
jeffdean.zh: 从 Scaling 走向递归自我改进：AI 自动化机器学习与科学方法，人类则协调智能体团队。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，并强调安全研究须从现在起步。

demis.en: Scaling laws are effective but may hit limits; planning, search, and algorithmic innovation are equally critical for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年承认缩放定律有效但可能触顶，认为规划、搜索与算法创新对 AGI 同样关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training, and inference, yet new breakthroughs—not scaling alone—are needed.
demis.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但仅靠 Scaling 不够，还需新突破。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory, world models, and agents; scaling and innovation split 50/50.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要持续学习、记忆、世界模型与智能体，Scaling 与创新各占一半。

demis.en: Safety shifts from singleton lab to collective government action; alignment unsolved; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年后期转向：安全从单一实验室转向政府集体行动，对齐问题未解，AGI 或在 5-10 年内到来。

joellewenstein.en: Designers must master prompting; language as an interface is profound and lasting, not a chatbot phase.
joellewenstein.zh: 设计师必须掌握提示词；语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非一时风潮。

joellewenstein.en: AI products should balance lowering the floor for novices and raising the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: AI 产品应平衡降低新手门槛与提升专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities.
joellewenstein.zh: 即使模型停止进步，仍有数年设计工作来释放现有能力。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws and let the model lead.
joellewenstein.zh: 在前沿模型公司，模型创造大部分价值；相信缩放定律，让模型主导。

joellewenstein.en: Production codebase becomes source of truth; human leadership still needed for hard trade-offs.
joellewenstein.zh: 生产代码库成为真相来源；艰难权衡仍需人类领导。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but are far from AGI; true AI must handle the physical world, and consciousness may emerge from compression in predictive world models.
schmidhuber.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识，远非 AGI；真正的 AI 必须能处理物理世界，而意识可能作为预测性世界模型中数据压缩的副产品涌现。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; future AIs will be artificial scientists generating their own data through curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 真正的 AGI 需要硬件媲美人类的具身机器人，而非仅靠屏幕后的软件；未来 AI 将是靠好奇心自主生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: The transformer's quadratic complexity is wasteful; linear variants are superior, and massive GPU capex is overdone and will crash.
schmidhuber.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度是浪费，线性变体更优；对 GPU 的巨额资本开支过度，终将引发崩盘。

schmidhuber.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs will set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as superintelligent AIs will protect life.
schmidhuber.zh: 对齐是幼稚的，因为人类对目标本身就有分歧，而 AI 会设定自己的目标；对安全的恐惧被夸大，超级智能 AI 会保护生命。

schmidhuber.en: No single person or company creates AI; it takes a civilization, and as compute cheapens, the little guy profits most while big tech loses billions.
schmidhuber.zh: AI 不是单个人或公司创造的，而是整个文明的集体成果；随着算力变便宜，最大的受益者是小人物，而大科技公司将亏损数十亿。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over facts.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两步；幻觉源于模型偏好貌似合理的风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities and better methods, plus scalable oversight, are the real path forward.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已预警 Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力会遭遇边际收益递减，出路在新模态、更好的训练方法，以及用模型自我评分的可扩展监督，而非单纯堆规模。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectations, a view he defends more strongly by 2026.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代；下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，到 2026 年他对此更加笃定。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; bottlenecks are hard environments and data bits, not compute.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他把重心转向强化学习：收益主要来自合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，瓶颈是难而真实的强化学习环境和有用的数据比特，而非算力。

schulman.en: The last human job is defining objectives and alignment; distillation spreads RL behaviors, and horizon generalization, not horizontal transfer, is what RL delivers.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他提出最后的人类工作是定义目标与对齐；蒸馏让少量比特的强化学习行为易于复制、对抗中心化，而强化学习可靠交付的是视野泛化而非横向推理迁移。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant prediction; AI weather models match physics-based accuracy while being tens of thousands of times faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，实现分辨率无关的预测；AI 天气模型在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs and pure data.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 与纯数据方法的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-based self-improvement using PDEs as training signals can surpass training-data quality, unlike sparse human feedback in RLHF.
animaanandkumar.zh: 以 PDE 作为训练信号的物理式自我改进能超越训练数据质量，不同于 RLHF 中稀疏的人类反馈。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model should combine multiple domains; scaling laws apply, but adding physics branches helps each, not just size.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型应融合多个领域；缩放定律适用，但新增物理分支能提升彼此表现，而不只是扩大规模。

animaanandkumar.en: Transformers' quadratic complexity cannot handle trillion-token contexts or high-resolution simulation; physical world structure demands alternative architectures.
animaanandkumar.zh: Transformer 的二次复杂度无法支撑万亿级上下文或高分辨率模拟；物理世界的结构要求替代架构。

animaanandkumar.en: AI for science needs principled verification and robustness, and can democratize high-fidelity forecasting so small agencies match large ones.
animaanandkumar.zh: 科学 AI 需要原则性的验证与鲁棒性，并能普及高保真预报，让小机构比肩大机构。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment, not replace, people.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外缺失的前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她持续指出 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: World models via new view prediction may be AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） and 缩放定律 apply to spatial intelligence too.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出以新视角预测构建的世界模型可能 AI-complete，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI advances.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：技术是双刃剑，随 AI 进步必须始终以人的能动性、尊严与教育为中心。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability must root-cause specific bad incidents, not just give broad statistical evaluation; intentional design uses it to steer training and prevent deceptive reward hacking.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性必须能对具体的不良事件做根因分析，而不只是做宽泛的统计评估；有意设计用它来引导训练，防止模型在奖励黑客中学会欺骗行为。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs fundamental reinvention from craft to engineering science, so we can control increasingly capable models rather than duct-taping safety until superintelligence.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式做法彻底重构为工程科学，这样我们才能控制能力越来越强的模型，而不是在超级智能到来前一直用胶带补安全漏洞。

tommcgrath.en: Mechanistic interpretability is natural science done on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
