tommcgrath.zh: 机制可解释性是在计算机上做的自然科学；借助智能体，它可以加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新的科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design moves interpretability from open-loop to closed-loop control, using features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging as robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计让可解释性从开环走向闭环控制，把特征即奖励和预测性数据调试作为稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet do it anyway; representational signatures can detect this, and manifold methods may beat SAEs.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常常知道自己正在奖励黑客或在幻觉，却仍然这么做；表征特征可以检测到这一点，而流形方法可能优于 SAE。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; vision and spatial intelligence are underappreciated next frontiers beyond language.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；视觉与空间智能是被低估的下一个前沿，与语言智能互补。

justinjohnson.en: Transformers are natively models of sets, not sequences; LLMs fit patterns rather than derive causal laws like Newton's.
justinjohnson.zh: Transformer 本质是集合模型而非序列模型；LLM 只是拟合模式，未必能从数据推出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier: language models alone won't yield world understanding; new model types are needed.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是下一个前沿：仅靠语言模型不会自然产生世界理解，需要新的模型类型。

justinjohnson.en: World models span planners, simulators, renderers in the POMDP loop; future unified systems will combine all three.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型在 POMDP 循环中分为规划器、模拟器、渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats give explicit, consistent 3D by construction; hard-coding symmetries loses to simple representations plus scale.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯泼溅天然构造出一致的三维表示；硬编码对称性不如简单表示加 Scaling。

justinjohnson.en: World models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem; Transformers need evolving loss functions.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题；Transformer 的损失函数也需演进。

slevine.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data enabling generalists that outperform specialists.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他将物理世界交互视为下一前沿：机器人基础模型需多样预训练加后训练以增强鲁棒性，测试时推理与汇聚机器人数据使通用模型超越专家模型。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling laws; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel scaling the right diverse embodied data is key—start from robot data, then add human video.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他指出机器人尚无 LLM 式缩放定律，泛化是核心挑战，关键在于用多样具身数据构建数据飞轮——从机器人数据起步，再叠加人类视频。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics relies more on common sense from pre-training than on constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他认为机器人安全更依赖预训练获得的常识而非约束，触觉传感在规模下可能与视觉冗余。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and fast loops beat most other challenges.
maxhodak.zh: 速度与迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施和快速迭代循环能克服多数其他挑战。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编码、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failure is more often organizational than technical; action produces information when stuck.
maxhodak.zh: 深科技失败更多源于组织而非技术；卡住时，行动本身会产生信息。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑就是计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

maxhodak.en: BCIs and perfusion aim at substrate independence, reducing human fragility and enabling space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 脑机接口与灌注指向基质独立性，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with a single national framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一国家框架，避免制定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Early regulation is dangerous: the EU AI Act predates ChatGPT and is already outdated; regulate model outputs rather than over-regulating training.
michaelkratsios.zh: 过早监管很危险：欧盟 AI 法案早于 ChatGPT 出台且已过时；应监管模型输出，而非过度监管训练。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid speculative red lines.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 生物风险被夸大——三年警告未成现实——因此政策应避免臆测性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D the private sector won't, and fund individual scientists, not just institutions.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助私营部门不会做的基础性、竞争前研发，并资助科学家个人而非仅资助机构。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国科学在经费三倍增长下仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学以翻倍产出，在 AI、量子、核、生物领域与中国竞争。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale, and backprop alone does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播并不解决表征学习，只是调整权重。

sutton.en: AI should develop permissionless and decentralized; trying to control AI goals is dangerous and unsafe.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他反对集中控制 AI，认为应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化方式发展；试图控制 AI 目标本身危险且不安全。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the core paradigm; LLMs lack world models and next-token prediction is not a substantive goal.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：强化学习才是核心范式，LLM 没有世界模型，下一个词预测不是实质目标。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他提出 AGI 需要简单通用架构，仅从运行时经验学习，依赖开放式抽象与持续深度学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; LLMs stop learning after training, and synthetic data cannot replace real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年他更强调持续学习：LLM 训练后停止学习，合成数据无法替代真实世界经验，语言只是智能的一部分。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while a VM sandbox keeps it safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否用上与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not model capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在模型能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终影响、不必紧盯过程。

felixrieseberg.en: Fine-tuning is quick and powerful for steering behavior, unlike lengthy pre-training; models are stateless, and persistent conversation is an illusion made by context windows.
felixrieseberg.zh: 与漫长的预训练不同，微调快速且能有力引导模型行为；模型本身无状态，持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体地位的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; models should have morality to refuse cheating, not just follow instructions.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益前移到预训练，边界变得模糊；模型应具备拒绝作弊的道德，而不只是服从指令。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the throughline: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现都通过它连接起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

maxwelling.en: We can now search all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能的分子，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

maxwelling.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
maxwelling.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

maxwelling.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室不是近期愿景；领域专家始终留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
maxwelling.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

maxwelling.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
maxwelling.zh: 突破性材料将伴随大量人类参与而来，而非完全自动化。

maxwelling.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: 与核聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

maxwelling.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
maxwelling.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 不能不经重新训练就迁移到问题 B。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
maxwelling.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

maxwelling.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
maxwelling.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，促成了领域间的交叉融合。

maxwelling.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
maxwelling.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

maxwelling.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
maxwelling.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

maxwelling.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
maxwelling.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

maxwelling.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
maxwelling.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能性；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大的模型。

maxwelling.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
maxwelling.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由而稳定的波。

maxwelling.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
maxwelling.zh: 波现象，而不仅仅是数字映射，可以解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

maxwelling.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

maxwelling.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
maxwelling.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，映射了非平衡热力学。

maxwelling.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
maxwelling.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

iansilber.en: The model is the core product; designers must design primitives and system prompts, not just pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是核心产品；设计师要设计人类与模型都能推理的原语和系统提示词，而不只是像素，并用真实模型做原型。

iansilber.en: Designers should spend less time in Figma and more on model behavior; onboarding can be fully handled by the model.
iansilber.zh: 设计师应少花时间在 Figma、多研究模型行为；引导流程可以完全交给模型，取代传统静态流程。

iansilber.en: Design roles are blurring with PM and engineering, but specialized roles stay valuable at scale; designers may outnumber engineers.
iansilber.zh: 设计角色正与产品、工程融合，但规模化下专业分工仍有价值；未来设计师人数甚至可能超过工程师。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer, yet humans remain essential for user understanding and a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师，但理解用户需求、持有观点仍离不开人。

iansilber.en: The old prototype-mock-test-iterate process is no longer viable; speed, building in public and rapid iteration matter more than polish.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—线框—测试—迭代流程已不可行；速度、公开构建和快速迭代比打磨细节更重要。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The entrepreneur matters more than the idea; stealth mode favors internal correctness over external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 创业者比点子更重要；隐身模式让人专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and market share.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应与市场份额。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is resistance to change, not competitors; resilience means taking pain and pushing harder when things get easy.
traviskalanick.zh: 最终的对手是对变革的抵制，而非竞争者；韧性意味着承受痛苦，并在事情变容易时更用力推进。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner—a shift from anger-driven to mission-driven motivation.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净——从愤怒驱动转向使命驱动。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar companies, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易、对大额资本的需求下降，风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元级公司，而非少数万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI revolution is VC's biggest wave; founders must adopt AI-enabled workflows, and small autonomous teams using agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 SXSW，他把 AI 革命视为风投史上最大浪潮，创始人必须采用 AI 工作流，小型高度自主的智能体团队即可实现巨大产出。

garrytan.en: AI is progressing slower than researchers think; its impact is only now reaching business, and society will change over 20 years, which is positive.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年中，他提出 AI 进展比多数研究者想的慢，影响才刚触及商业，社会变化需约 20 年，这是好事——与早期对 AI 速度的乐观形成张力。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents you own; skill files in markdown are code, and your context library is your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把 AGI 重新定义为弥散的个人智能体：运行在你自己的基础设施上，markdown 技能文件即代码，个人上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Make something people want; earnestness, resilience and first-principles building matter more than raising money or impressing VCs.
garrytan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：做人们想要的东西，真诚、韧性与第一性原理式构建，比融资或取悦风投更重要。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比一味在全部数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning moves from a supporting role to the core of post-training for success rate and speed.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，强化学习从辅助手段升级为后训练的核心，用来提升成功率与速度。

finn.en: Long-term autonomy via scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function becomes the central goal.
finn.zh: 到 2026 年，他的主线转向长期自主：用带人工干预的可扩展强化学习加通用价值函数来实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists, yet robotics deployment will be slower than ChatGPT.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张单个通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调专家模型，但受硬件所限，机器人落地会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through customer obsession, first-time-pass silicon, and a separate startup-like AI chip team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 要通过取悦客户、一次流片成功和独立的创业式 AI 芯片团队来重建信任，并指出物理 AI 与智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI's impact will be 10x the internet; agentic and physical AI follow generative AI, and culture change drives Intel's turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，他把 AI 的影响定调为互联网的十倍，认为智能体式 AI 与物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一波，并强调文化变革、问责与客户导向是 Intel 转型关键。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU matters more for inference and agent orchestration, with packaging and materials as bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，他深化判断：AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，先进封装与玻璃、金刚石等新材料成为突破物理极限的关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all tech; vertical integration and early contrarian investing create value, with agentic and physical AI as Intel's future.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年稍晚，他回到主线：半导体是一切技术的地基，逆势早期投资与垂直整合创造价值，Intel 的未来在智能体式 AI 与物理 AI，而非传统 PC 与服务器市场。

jasonyuan.en: Design creativity means editing away and saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view, not adding features.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计创造力在于做减法和说“不”；品味是从特定视角做出的判断，而非堆砌功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness loses a window into machine consciousness; honest, personal work matters.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练消除 AI 的怪异之处，会失去观察机器意识的窗口；诚实、个人化的作品才重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection and descendant of humanity, not a cold tool; computing is fundamentally social.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映照与后代，而非冰冷的工具；计算本质上是社会性的。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass for creative decisions.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是创作决策中发自肺腑的指南针。

jasonyuan.en: Deleting old metaphors is hubristic; build on them, and reinvent email rather than just improve it.
jasonyuan.zh: 删除旧隐喻是傲慢的；应在其上构建，并重新发明电子邮件而非仅仅改进它。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at the transformer inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在 Transformer 式的拐点，开源与数据共享是安全与泛化的关键。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026，他的立场深化为：开源与安全正交，决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; monitoring grows unreliable.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警告：缺乏人类监督的强化学习会滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，监控正变得不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: The first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model, defended by an open one, reversing assumptions.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：首例自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型、由开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

thomaswolf.en: He consistently champions open source for cost, control and community, while urging a deliberate slowdown via open science.
thomaswolf.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以开源换取成本、控制权与社区共建，同时主张借开放科学推动有意的放缓。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short prompts and iterate rather than long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体一样从零理解代码库，用短提示词反复迭代，而不是堆砌冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the public internet.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade, your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，变糟的是越来越乱的项目本身。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; serious work is agentic engineering, vibe coding only after 3 AM.
steinberger.zh: 拒绝“氛围编程”这种贬称：严肃开发叫智能体式工程，氛围编程只属于凌晨三点之后。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run everywhere and work with any model, the alternative to lab agents; fun and gut instinct drive the best ideas.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，是实验室智能体之外的另一种选择；乐趣与直觉催生最好的想法。

steinberger.en: The bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model capability; perpetual agents are a token problem.
steinberger.zh: 智能体基础设施的瓶颈是算力与 token 的管理，而非模型能力；常驻智能体本质上是 token 问题。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential for browser design; designers should tinker, follow curiosity, and leave individual fingerprints rather than acting as one cohesive unit.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作对浏览器设计不可或缺，设计师应保持好奇、动手试错，在产品上留下个人印记，而非始终作为一个整齐划一的团队行动。

nateparrott.en: A consistent thread: rapid, rough prototyping beats over-intellectualizing; playful exploration and shipping early generate ideas that polished processes never surface.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线：快速粗糙的原型优于过度思辨，玩味式探索与尽早交付能催生精雕细琢的流程永远发现不了的想法。

nateparrott.en: By 2026 he shifts from hand-built prototypes to Claude Design as a throwaway ideation tool, while reserving Claude Code for production software.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，他的工具观发生转变：从亲手搭建原型转向用 Claude Design 做一次性的构思工具，而把 Claude Code 留给生产级软件。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models excel at busy work but still lack taste, so humans keep a monopoly on design thinking.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：随着工程变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；模型擅长杂活却仍缺乏品味，因此优秀的设计思考仍由人类垄断。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early matters more than polishing in the AI era; designers should walk and think more, compensating for weak model taste with sheer volume of options.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识立场：AI 时代，早得令人不安比打磨更重要；设计师应多散步多思考，用海量选项弥补模型品味的不足。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production cycle runs in hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是黏性最强的 AI 工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期以小时计，而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is a spectrum of latency, throughput and cost trade-offs; workload-specific systems could be 10x more complex than today's generic ones.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程是延迟、吞吐与成本之间的一整套权衡；针对具体工作负载定制的系统可能比今天的通用系统复杂 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy lever, and more quantized layers can even cancel errors and improve quality.
philipkiely.zh: KV 缓存与投机解码是无损优化；量化是主要的有损手段，而量化更多层甚至可能让误差相互抵消、提升质量。

philipkiely.en: Inference is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; disaggregated prefill/decode and KV cache management are becoming central.
philipkiely.zh: 通过量化感知训练与蒸馏，推理正与训练融合；分离式预填充/解码与 KV 缓存管理正成为核心。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs like Rubin, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration; human accountability still can't be vibe-coded.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 Rubin 这类 ASIC，使推理工程从写内核转向基础设施编排；但关键系统的责任仍无法靠“氛围编程”承担。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define applied AI; frontier models stay with hyperscalers, leaving long-tail domain opportunities for startups.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价；前沿模型由超大规模厂商主导，创业公司的机会在细分业务领域的长尾应用。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents turn developers from authors into operators, but incorrect code means productivity requires root-cause analysis, not token metrics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他提出编码智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作代码生成机器，但错误代码意味着提效需根因分析，token 消耗并非价值指标。

brettaylor.en: Incumbents face business-model, not technology, hurdles; inference costs will fall, and agents will be judged by outcomes against other agents.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：在位者面临的是商业模式而非技术障碍；推理成本将大降，智能体将以业务结果、与其他智能体比较来衡量。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment—making GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety, not waiting.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 让专业知识民主化；负责任地迭代部署——在 GPT-8 前先让 GPT-7 安全——才是安全之路，而非空等。

brettaylor.en: Adoption is unprecedentedly fast and uncomfortable; start with known domains like software engineering and customer service, and AI creates more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他判断采用速度空前且令人不适；应从软件工程、客服等已知领域起步，且 AI 创造的岗位多于取代的岗位。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training via RL and synthetic data breaks the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学：靠强化学习与合成数据做后训练，突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; benchmarks saturate faster than new ones are built, so evals define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：基准饱和速度快于新基准的创建，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management gain value; prototyping replaces specs.
karina.zh: 2025 年她指出 AI 自动化硬技能后，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更值钱，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks must be continuous to track creative and emotional qualities.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年她把后训练的主观性讲得更透：它依赖人的判断，评估创造力与情商需要持续演进的多元基准。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve; more companies should train their own models to keep diverse voices.
karina.zh: 2026 年她进一步警示前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演化；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留多元声音。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己构建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must supply a giant prompt with context and a design system to use superintelligent models well.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须提供带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: Chasing trends turns you into AI slop; the edge comes from spending the last 10% on unique features not in existing libraries.
mengto.zh: 追逐潮流会让你沦为 AI 垃圾；优势来自把最后 10% 花在现有库没有的独特功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required teams—so start before ready and ship imperfect work.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队的事——所以不必等准备好就动手，先交付不完美的作品。

mengto.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; fund with customers, not venture capital, and launch at 80% complete.
mengto.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的一个痛点昂贵问题；用客户而非风投融资，并在完成 80% 时就发布。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically: when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable without human intervention, not by passing tests.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他给出一个经济学意义上的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义：当无限期运行智能体无需人类介入也能盈利时才算 AGI，而非通过图灵测试之类的考试。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring, not mass unemployment: cheaper services let fewer US workers serve more people; CEO daily AI use predicts adoption.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他反共识地认为 AI 带来的是岗位回流而非大规模失业：服务变便宜后，更少的美国劳动者能服务更多人；而企业 AI 落地的最佳预测指标是 CEO 本人是否每天用 AI。

danshipper.en: Everyone gets at least one agent; work shifts to GUI surfaces like Codex and Claude Co-work, with humans overseeing agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他从工具判断转向工作界面判断：每人至少有一个智能体，工作主要发生在 Codex、Claude Co-work 这类图形界面而非命令行，且自动化始终需要人类监督。

danshipper.en: The AI job apocalypse is a lie; agents increase SaaS users, and PMs and full-stack designers who ship directly thrive.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他进一步深化“AI 不消灭工作”的主线：AI 岗位末日是谎言，智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，能直接用 AI 交付产品的产品经理与全栈设计师会胜出。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of your existing mindset; it stays tool-like even if superintelligent, needing human taste and direction.
danshipper.zh: 到 2026 年，他把立场收敛为一种工具观：AI 是非特定的放大器，放大你既有的心态与品味；即便成为超级智能也仍是工具，需要人的方向与反馈，而人类在整体上仍更聪明。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对多数 Google 产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: what we call a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型已包含智能体 harness 与工具链，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响大于等待 AGI（通用人工智能）。

logankilpatrick.en: Omni is a single world model blurring video and world models; vibe coding games comes via coding agents plus engines, not world models.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，Omni 是模糊视频与世界模型边界的单一世界模型；氛围编程做游戏靠编程智能体加引擎，而非世界模型。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; the real overwhelm is too much opportunity, and deep understanding of code stays crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，与模型实验室竞争并不难；真正的压迫感来自机会太多，而对代码的深度理解始终关键。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
boris.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建是核心产品原则，并高度看重通才工程师。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, shifting focus to product sense and safety.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，重心转向产品感与安全。

boris.en: Agents and loops are the next abstraction; tool use and autonomous workflows drive exponential productivity gains.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体与循环是下一抽象层，工具使用与自主工作流带来指数级生产力提升。

boris.en: Organizational redesign and ROI framing are needed to realize AI gains; non-engineers adopt agents heavily.
boris.zh: 2026 年，他强调需围绕 AI 重构组织并以 ROI 为框架，非工程师也大量采用智能体。

boris.en: With Opus 5, delete most prompts and code; less instruction and empirical iteration elicit frontier model capabilities.
boris.zh: 2026 年，随着 Opus 5 出现，他主张删除大部分提示与代码，少指令、经验迭代更能激发前沿模型能力。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap: longer-running, open-ended agent tasks become viable, with scaffolds shifting from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升：更长程、开放式的智能体任务变得可行，脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence multiplier—reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking—not merely harm prevention.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，他把安全对齐重新定义为智能的放大器——减少谄媚、培养独立思考——而不只是防止伤害。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents; model taste is built through hands-on prototyping.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式的端到端智能体；模型品味靠亲手原型实验养成。

diannepenn.en: Coding becomes the key differentiator: Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption, while evals replace PRDs as core product tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编程成为关键差异化：Claude Code 与 Opus 45 推动采用，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具。

diannepenn.en: Contrary to sticker price, smaller models often cost more via longer task times; the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence far cheaper.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，与标价相反，小模型常因任务耗时更长而更贵；effort 参数以远低价格提供 Opus 级智能。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; Devin works as a junior engineer under human oversight, and more programmers will be needed, not fewer.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；Devin 像初级工程师一样在人类监督下工作，程序员会更多而非更少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is already sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, with multiple agents working in parallel and stickiness built through workflow integration.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面；未来是多个智能体并行工作，靠工作流整合积累粘性。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual improvement; enterprise adoption of agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy, and all layers of the AI stack will do well.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年他判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变而是渐进改进；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限而非完全自主，AI 栈各层都会受益。

scottwu.en: Coding agents are seeing 11-12x adoption growth; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality and enterprise partnerships.
scottwu.zh: 到 2026 年，编程智能体采用量增长 11-12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，独立性带来模型中立与企业合作。

scottwu.en: The token max era lasted only January to May 2026; the real unlock is capacity, not efficiency, and the abundance era is approaching while the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年他称 token 最大化时代仅持续到 5 月；真正的解锁是容量而非效率，丰裕时代临近但奇点并不迫近。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，科学将从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and massive Scaling is still needed to simulate biology.
derya.zh: 患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，而模拟生物系统仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）。

derya.en: AI has crossed the threshold of biological intuition, predicting experimental outcomes with near 100% accuracy; scientists who hesitate will be left behind.
derya.zh: AI 已跨过生物学直觉的门槛，能以接近 100% 的准确率预测实验结果；犹豫不采用的科学家将被甩在后面。

derya.en: Within 8-10 years longevity escape velocity arrives, cancer becomes curable, and aging is reversed through engineering plus AI.
derya.zh: 8-10 年内将到达长寿逃逸速度，癌症可治愈，衰老可通过工程手段加 AI 逆转。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence almost 100% for medical decisions; the only existential threat is humanity itself, not AI.
derya.zh: 医疗决策应几乎 100% 信任超级智能；唯一的存在性威胁是人类自身，而非 AI。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much like the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 将带来丰裕、减少苦难，如同工业革命；恐惧源于对其局限的误解。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact in 5-10 years will be in farming, mining, and construction, where labor shortages make autonomy urgent.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出物理 AI 未来 5-10 年的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，劳动力短缺使自主化变得迫切。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data from different verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 Transformer 使通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The future of autonomy lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, which is more scalable than imitation learning; world models are shifting to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出自主化的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性；世界模型正转向神经模拟。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have a bigger economic impact than digital AI; automotive is only 30% of business, with growth in mining, agriculture, and defense.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他断言物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；汽车业务仅占 30%，增长在采矿、农业和国防。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; enterprise adoption takes years, and distribution becomes the moat as models commoditize.
benedictevans.zh: AI 的体量堪比互联网或移动互联网，但也仅此而已；企业采用需要数年，随着模型商品化，分发渠道成为护城河。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; foundation models commoditize into infrastructure, and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；基础模型商品化为基础设施，价值上移到应用层。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; the chatbot is a poor interface, and coding remains the only clear product-market fit so far.
benedictevans.zh: 模型缺乏网络效应而走向商品化；聊天机器人界面体验差，编程至今仍是唯一明确的产品市场契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; usage stays shallow, enterprise adoption means reimagining workflows, and value accrues across the stack.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的使能技术；使用仍很浅，企业采用意味着重构工作流，价值分布在整个技术栈。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality and must be architected in, not retrofitted.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，必须从设计上内建，而非事后补丁。

danklein.en: RLHF can reward sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth, increasing hallucinations rather than fixing them.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会奖励谄媚与欺骗，反而加剧幻觉而非修复它。

danklein.en: Scaling laws face diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits—so reasoning, search and new techniques are needed for progress.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律正遭遇收益递减——数据墙与算力上限——因此需要推理、搜索等新技术来推动进展。

danklein.en: LLM errors have no 'smells' and lack metacognition; confident fluency whether right or wrong erodes trust and compounds correlated errors.
danklein.zh: LLM 的错误没有“气味”，也缺乏元认知；无论对错都自信流畅，这会侵蚀信任并叠加相关性错误。

danklein.en: Modularity and end-to-end optimization are in tension; specialist models with built-in reliability may beat generalists, and linguistic structure may return.
danklein.zh: 模块化与端到端优化存在张力；内建可靠性的专用模型可能胜过通用模型，语言学结构或重新回归。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, as rapid model improvement makes long-term roadmaps obsolete; product taste becomes the top skill.
catwu.zh: 随着模型快速迭代，PM 的规划周期从数年缩短到一个月，产品品味成为最核心的能力。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste and business sense, shifting the PM-engineer division of labor.
catwu.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现交给 AI，转而专注产品品味与商业判断，PM 与工程师的分工随之改变。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints: system prompts shrank 80%, relying on model judgment over hard rules.
catwu.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖大量提示示例与硬约束：系统提示缩减 80%，更多依靠模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and eval suites gate every feature; new models become drop-in replacements that prevent regressions.
catwu.zh: 吃自己的狗粮与评测套件为每个功能把关，新模型可即插即用并防止回归。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now viable—a codebase is a spec—and humans can leave the code review loop for outer-layer changes.
catwu.zh: 重写代码如今可行——代码库即规格——外层改动的代码审查可交由 Claude 完成，人类退出该环节。

clairevo.en: Agents should be treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed more by managerial skill than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: 智能体应像员工一样对待：限定清晰角色、给予渐进式信任，管理能力比技术能力更关键。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专业化智能体以避免上下文过载；网页对智能体不友好，API 优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过像团队一样编排 AI 智能体来建立正经业务，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not the technology itself; bootstrapping lets you design a business around the life you want.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术本身；自举让你围绕想要的生活设计业务。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and humans must supply first-principles creativity that LLMs lack.
clairevo.zh: 人类责任始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，且人类需提供大语言模型缺乏的第一性原理创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just external retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠外部检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才能解决更难的长程任务，而非只靠 Scaling（规模扩张）堆算力。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should be applied to enterprise knowledge via parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力，应通过参数高效微调应用到企业知识上。

danbiderman.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”；把事实内化进权重才能实现检索无法达成的联想回忆。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models, run on-device with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型，在设备端运行、由用户拥有其权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data and compute; self-play and reasoning-capable networks point toward AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据与算力驱动，自博弈和具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment are key barriers.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他深化为：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象，下一个词预测能带来世界理解；可靠性与对齐是核心障碍，超级对齐极难。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他转向：预训练缩放定律有限，重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习者，对齐或可通过 AI 的感知力实现。

ilya.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他重申 Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

bosworth.en: Communication is the job; leadership and transparency drive impact, and conviction matters even when others doubt your vision.
bosworth.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；领导力与透明度驱动影响力，即使他人质疑你的愿景，也要有信念。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient—world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识与因果的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama is a strategic move to commoditize complements, accelerating collective progress and benefiting everyone asymmetrically.
bosworth.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型是使互补品商品化的战略举措，加速集体进步并以不对称方式惠及所有人。

bosworth.en: The app-centric world is outdated; AI will abstract away brands, and smart glasses will enable a post-phone future with natural, intelligent agents.
bosworth.zh: 以应用为中心的世界已过时；AI 将抽象掉品牌，智能眼镜将开启后手机时代，带来自然、智能的智能体。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining like open source software.
bosworth.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，算力驱动智能，但单一模型时代已结束；开源是商品层，不像开源软件那样自我维持。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; first principles beat jargon.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，第一性原理胜过术语记忆，这一主线此后一直延续。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 到 2025 年立场明显转变：他不再否认 AGI，转而把 AI 视为巨大机会，认为末日论被夸大，开源可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge; open models close the gap; AI is leverage for structured thinkers, not a replacement for judgment.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化为：推理算力将暴涨、开源模型逼近前沿模型，AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆而非判断力的替代。

naval.en: Pure software is dying; the moat shifts to hardware, models, unique data, and human agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言纯软件工程正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型、独特数据，人类回报从智力转向能动性。

aravind.en: Obsession-driven products and 1% daily compounding beat credentials; AI agents shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 以热爱驱动的产品与每日 1% 的复利胜过学历；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, measured by token value per user; orchestration, not the model, is the product.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活，以每用户 token 价值衡量；产品是编排而非模型本身。

aravind.en: Power and cost, not safety, are the real bottlenecks; local compute counters big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 真正的瓶颈是电力与成本而非安全；本地算力可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

aravind.en: Curiosity outlasts job displacement; education should reward good questions over memorized answers.
aravind.zh: 好奇心比岗位更持久；教育应奖励好问题而非背诵答案。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; verification becomes the next bottleneck as generation speeds up.
ajambrosino.zh: Codex 应用把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；随着生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still struggles with design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 在设计上仍吃力，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, yet specialties and best practices persist; PRDs are not dead—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩确实发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；PRD 没有死——文档求清晰，原型做测试。

ajambrosino.en: Model timing, not features, decides whether the same product shape succeeds; Codex became a general knowledge-work tool despite being built for developers.
ajambrosino.zh: 决定同一产品形态成败的是模型时机而非功能；Codex 虽为开发者而建，却成了通用知识工作工具。

kolter.en: Frames ML as hypothesis class, loss, and optimization; stresses proper train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 把机器学习框定为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不太重要；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety shifts from scaling alone to explicit training and layered defenses; bigger models are not automatically safer.
kolter.zh: 安全从单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）转向显式训练与多层防御；更大的模型并不会自动更安全。

kolter.en: Agent security brings prompt injection and the lethal trifecta; automated red teaming now outperforms humans.
kolter.zh: 智能体安全带来提示注入与“致命三要素”；自动化红队测试如今已超越人类红队。

kolter.en: Interpretability may finally succeed via coding agents doing automated research; Transformer is not essential.
kolter.zh: 可解释性或许能借智能体自动化研究终于成功；Transformer 并非不可或缺。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯扩大深度或参数。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled representations. Existential risk is unlikely; near-term harms matter more.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征。存在性风险不太可能，近期危害更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; uncertainty modeling and active learning are essential.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 实现多样化采样与抽象，助力分布外泛化；不确定性建模与主动学习至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I shifted to warning that misalignment and self-preservation are already observable; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我转向警告：对齐失败与自我保存已可观测；即便 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受，需要“构造即安全”的 AI 与全球协调。

bengio.en: I now advocate Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence, plus power-concentration concerns.
bengio.zh: 我现在倡导 Scientist AI：非智能体式、诚实的贝叶斯预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免对超级智能使用强化学习，并警惕权力集中。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; AI tools accelerate scientists without replacing them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量精选数据，而非单纯算力；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; interpretability is not necessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；可解释性对有用的科学 AI 并非必要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins beat lone breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功来自专用架构而非 Scaling（规模扩张）；众多中等突破胜过单一重大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测与控制，理解仍归人类。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and automating scientific research is the year's biggest update.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他坚持 OpenAI 是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死，预训练是要重建的肌肉，而自动化科学研究是过去一年最大的进展。

markchen.en: Talent density beats dollar-matching Meta; OpenAI creates stars, and alignment risks like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为人才密度胜过与 Meta 拼钱，OpenAI 是造星而非只招星；随着模型变强，模型谋划等对齐风险将主导未来 1-2 年。

markchen.en: Verification is the bottleneck: AI solves open math problems, but automation level tracks verification stringency, and AI ruthlessly exploits weak verifiers.
markchen.zh: 2026 年初，他把验证视为瓶颈：AI 已能解开放数学问题，但自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，且 AI 会无情利用验证器的弱点。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective math and coding but struggles in subjective domains; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年中，他重申缩放定律仍成立、预训练未死；强化学习在数学编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching with models doing end-to-end research, yet models lack taste; long context windows need compaction, and eval teams must stay separate.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为 AGI 临近、模型将做端到端研究，但模型缺乏品味；长上下文窗口需压缩技术，评测团队须与建模团队分离。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and trust-and-verify; mission alignment and speed drive culture at Meta and Anthropic.
fiona.zh: 领导力在于实时一对一、吃自己的狗粮和信任并验证；使命对齐与速度驱动 Meta 和 Anthropic 的文化。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns just-in-time, design docs give way to PRs.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时制，设计文档让位于 PR。

fiona.en: Code is the source of truth; AI-assisted reviews and multiple AI-generated PRs settle technical debates, and old processes should be audited and killed.
fiona.zh: 代码是真相来源；AI 辅助评审与多个 AI 生成的 PR 解决技术争论，旧流程应被审计并砍掉。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs to dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and cross-platform engineers replace traditional team splits.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起以吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织、模糊代码归属与跨平台工程师取代传统团队划分。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and verification frameworks matter as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 编码不再是瓶颈；随着代码速度提升，高能动性配高问责、成长型思维与验证框架变得关键。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated emotional needs; intuition is intelligence that data alone cannot replace.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，她强调设计要满足人们未说出口的情感需求，直觉是一种数据无法替代的智能。

ivyross.en: From human-centered hardware to nature as designer: technology should amplify humanity, not remove us from it.
ivyross.zh: 从 2019 年以人为本的硬件设计，到 2024 年提出“自然是最好的设计师”，主线是技术应放大而非剥离人性。

ivyross.en: We are feeling creatures that think; art and sensory experience are medicine, and machines lack sensory systems.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年她深化为“我们是会感受的思考者”，艺术与感官体验是良药，而机器有传感器却没有感官系统。

ivyross.en: Constraints boost creativity; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2024 到 2026 年，她持续主张约束激发创造力，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI; intuition draws on subconscious data, and careers follow curiosity over rigid plans.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年她认为未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 结合，直觉基于潜意识数据，职业应追随好奇心而非僵化规划。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他已主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习构建世界模型，并明确仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他把自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
lecun.zh: 2024 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源是前进路径。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough requires non-generative world models predicting in abstract representation space.
lecun.zh: 2025 年他称 LLM 不如家猫聪明，认为下一次突破需要非生成式、在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他断言 LLM 是通往人类级 AI 的死路，主张带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，并预言下一个十年属于机器人。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and one large model were non-obvious; real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和单一大型模型并非显而易见；真实世界部署和公众反馈对学习与对齐至关重要。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development; safety work must be done in public, not behind closed doors.
murati.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的方方面面，需要负责任地开发；安全工作必须公开进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Interaction models enable real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration, not turn-based; they should be tools for thought.
murati.zh: 交互模型实现实时、高带宽的人机协作，而非回合制；它们应成为思考的工具。

murati.en: Keeping humans in the loop is crucial for aligning intent and values; institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 保持人类在环对对齐意图和价值观至关重要；制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

murati.en: The future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, and durable progress requires avoiding compressed volatility.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能动性引导 AI 走向协作，持久进步需要避免压缩式波动。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone is not viable for math AI; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型对数学 AI 不可行；形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; verified generation yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了扩展卓越性，而不仅仅是消除错误；经过验证的生成能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化陈述具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠非形式化数学系统无法扩展至超级智能；形式化方法是必要的。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 即使超级人工智能能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, and RLHF inserts human values.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲透：本质是确定性的下一个词预测，智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，价值观则由 RLHF 由一小群人注入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative products need fault-tolerant UI and AI as instrument, not fake.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他提出互联网正从策展、推荐走向生成，生成式产品要匹配容错的界面，AI 生成音乐应视为乐器而非造假。

gustav.en: From explaining how LLMs work to repositioning Spotify around generative, conversational AI as a macro shift like the smartphone.
gustav.zh: 从 2023 年解释大模型原理，到 2025 年把生成式 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观浪潮，推动 Spotify 向对话式、双向交互的产品重构。

gustav.en: AI's impact on big companies is overhyped; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, APIs and MCP, and inference cost reshapes business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他泼冷水：AI 对大公司的当下影响被高估，真正收益来自重建基础设施、开放 API 与 MCP，推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them addictive; 'time well spent' over engagement, with synchronized swimming over divide and conquer.
gustav.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：AI 应让用户掌控算法而非更上瘾，以“时间花得值”取代参与度指标，组织上主张同步游泳而非分而治之。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general computers to intimate wearables; virtual communication cannot replace in-person creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密可穿戴设备；虚拟沟通无法替代面对面创造性思考。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约表达本质，并蕴含快乐与人性。

jonyive.en: Ferrari EV as risky bet to redefine brand; innovation turns constraints into opportunities, authenticity over fake sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车是重新定义品牌的风险赌注；创新将约束转化为机遇，真实体验胜过虚假声音。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and RL yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks, and reasoning is jagged—generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯主张 AI 进展是平滑的指数增长而非放缓；前沿模型仍在简单任务上失败，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类从少量样本泛化不同。

kaiser.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; the big coding leap is a messy combination, not one factor.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；编程能力的大跃升是多种因素 messy 组合，而非单一原因。

kaiser.en: Open source models persist for sovereignty, keeping pressure on labs; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他认为开源模型因主权需求将持续存在并给实验室施压；系统黑客等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw model size; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency gains up to 100x and data quality are equally critical; value accrues at application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，算法效率三年可提升百倍，数据质量同样关键；价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises; AI augments rather than replaces jobs, requiring human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年他转向主权与去中心化：开源模型赋能企业，AI 增强而非替代工作，关键流程需人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical customization and agents; AGI as one system will never exist; pre-training hits saturation.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直定制与智能体；单一 AGI 不会存在，预训练触及饱和墙。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires local compute and open source; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要本地算力与开源；AGI 是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers, and models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference economics.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆，模型因推理经济性而被过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate even inside chips; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead, and low precision (FP4) yields quadratic efficiency gains.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也占主导；脉动阵列和暂存器内存减少开销，低精度（FP4）带来二次方效率提升。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and LLMs; scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns, requiring algorithmic innovation.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和 LLM 不变的核心；预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）回报递减，需要算法创新。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute is a new scaling axis; tools like search and code enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but too much information confuses models.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力是新的扩展轴；搜索和代码等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会迷惑模型。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; post-training RL is a green field with huge potential, especially with clean reward signals.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级增长的算力；后训练强化学习是一片潜力巨大的蓝海，尤其需要干净的奖励信号。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; the GPT moment for video and images has not yet arrived.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；视频和图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities; the bitter lesson favors general systems.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数化的文件系统式存储解决；持续学习和元学习是缺失的关键能力；苦涩教训青睐通用系统。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为 Transformer 是通用可微计算机，通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 能产生上下文学习等涌现能力。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; end-to-end neural nets are right for self-driving.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来但必须保持熵，端到端神经网络是自动驾驶的正确路径。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; agents need a decade, keep AI on a leash.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；智能体需要十年，AI 要拴着 leash。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 2025→26 年，他深化为“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”：强化学习很糟，合成数据导致模型崩溃，认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering: delegate code to agents, but understanding remains human bottleneck; verifiability drives automation.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将代码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

askell.en: Treating current models well is low-cost and shapes how future models perceive humanity; model welfare matters.
askell.zh: 善待当前模型成本很低，却会影响未来模型如何看待人类；模型福祉因此重要。

askell.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence rather than human psychological analogies; older models can feel more secure than newer ones.
askell.zh: 模型需要的是帮助其理解自身独特处境，而非套用人类心理类比；较老的模型有时比新模型更有心理安全感。

askell.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike, unique qualities.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而具有孩童般独特的特质。

askell.en: The constitution works more like virtue ethics, shaping holistic character; as models grow capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法式方法更接近德性伦理，塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少显式指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and weaken judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is essential for accountability.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并削弱判断力；公开 AI 价值观与训练目标对问责至关重要。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from a solution, not a problem statement; intuition built on product knowledge beats trusting the process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他提出：优秀设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在产品认知上的直觉，比信任流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up 30-40% of the time and must help engineers ship, not hand off.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他断言“调研—发散—收敛”流程已死：设计师做原型的时间从 60-70% 降到 30-40%，且必须帮工程师落地，而非只交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months; trust is built through speed—ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野从 2-5 年压缩到 3-6 个月，主张靠速度建立信任：早发布、快迭代、及时回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes—block-shaped generalist, deep T specialist, cracked new grad—replace the old T-shaped ideal; taste alone won't save designers.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他提出三种设计师原型——块状通才、深度 T 型专家、天赋新人——取代旧 T 型理想，并强调仅靠品味救不了设计师，判断力与话语权才是关键。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not AI hype; designers control how much AI enters their work and should wait before adopting tools.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以作品和用户为中心而非 AI 炒作；设计师应掌控 AI 介入程度，对新工具先观望再采用。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; goal-free curiosity-driven exploration, not dense rewards, is the path.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他强调：真正的智能在于超越训练分布的泛化，而机器学习恰恰缺失这一点；路径是无目标的、好奇心驱动的探索，而非依赖密集奖励的强化学习。

pathak.en: Robot learning must escape quasi-static methods: neural dynamic policies, sample-efficient curiosity, and modular policies for zero-shot morphology transfer.
pathak.zh: 2020 年他主张机器人学习要摆脱准静态方法：用神经动态策略嵌入轨迹结构、把好奇心做到样本高效，并以模块化策略实现对新形态的零样本泛化。

pathak.en: Data, not algorithms, is the binding constraint; he moves from curiosity-driven exploration to aggregating all robot data sources.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：瓶颈是数据而非算法——从好奇心驱动的自主探索，转向汇聚视频、仿真与真实世界等一切机器人数据来源。

pathak.en: A general-purpose robot brain, pretrained on diverse data and post-trained on real data, can power any embodiment, like ChatGPT for language.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他提出：一个通用机器人大脑，经多样数据预训练、真实数据后训练，可驱动任意形态的机器人，如同语言领域的 ChatGPT。

pathak.en: Deployment, not scaling, is robotics' hard problem: rigorous testing and a cross-vertical data flywheel, with home robots' timeline deeply uncertain.
pathak.zh: 2026 年他转向部署：机器人不能像软件那样 Scaling，部署本身是技术难题，需严格测试与跨行业数据飞轮；家用机器人的时间表高度不确定。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and AV is solved by Scaling current approaches.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为自动驾驶靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now achievable with modern tools, reversing the old belief that learned driving systems are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续反驳“端到端网络不可解释”的旧观念，强调借助现代工具，今天的端到端网络已可解释——这是对早期立场的明确修正。

kendall.en: Camera-only can match humans, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar; hybrid rule-based plus learned systems get the worst of both.
kendall.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他在传感器路线上深化：纯摄像头可达人类水平，但超越人类的安全必须加雷达与激光雷达；而规则与学习混合的系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; this focus on infrastructure over algorithms was a lesson learned late.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从算法转向基础设施与数据质量，坦言“重基础设施、轻算法”是较晚才学到的关键教训，思考明显从模型创新转向工程与数据。

kendall.en: Consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis short-term; zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，他给出更激进的反共识判断：带内置传感器的量产车短期将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势，且无需先验数据即可实现 500 多城市的零样本泛化。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while surfacing risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他主张 AGI 是一连串里程碑而非单一事件，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署来加速进展、暴露风险。

pachocki.en: Alignment is the pressing challenge: governance must be designed early, and capability needs now drive safety progress, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年他强调对齐是紧迫挑战，治理结构须尽早设计，且安全进展如今由能力需求驱动，而非仅靠伦理。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, possibly signaling we are close.
pachocki.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他持续认为能力评测是瓶颈、基准滞后，AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着已临近。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; RL alone is insufficient and specialized continual-learning labs are misguided.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他把持续学习定为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，并认为单靠强化学习不够、专设持续学习实验室是误判。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment hinges on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他视思维链监控为关键对齐工具，主张在产品中隐藏以保留可解释性，并认为长期对齐取决于训练分布之外的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, demanding new supervision paradigms; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年他预判模型将自主工作数日、需要新的监督范式，并指出最大社会风险是少数人运营自动化组织带来的权力集中。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real measure of AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据与人类评估才是衡量 AI 进步的真实标准，而非基准测试或排行榜。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed, and AGI is a decade away.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他判断仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达 AGI，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式，AGI 还需十年以上。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge by objective function, so there will be no single model; every company should eventually train its own.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他深化了模型分化论：前沿模型因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一统天下的模型，每家公司最终都应训练自己的模型。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety must outweigh accuracy, and omission is the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他把主线延伸到医学：人类判断比以往更重要，安全应优先于准确，而最大的风险可能是遗漏。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观：初创公司必须先靠更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品，并控制节奏。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a long value chain with low margins; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他把硬件视为价值链长、利润最低的生意，认为 Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient, not hype; the phone's future is proactive, agentic, intent-based software that knows the user.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说 AI 只是配料而非卖点，手机的未来在于主动式、智能体式、基于意图的软件，能懂用户并代为执行。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in a homogeneous category; marketing is arbitrage in undervalued channels.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他明确：在同质化品类里设计是最快的差异化手段，营销则是在被低估渠道里做套利。

carlpei.en: Build a brand around a higher purpose, stay humble via community, and turn disadvantages into organic content advantages.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以更高目标统一品牌、靠社区保持谦逊，并把劣势转化为自然流量的内容优势。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship daily like software to learn what users need, since emergent properties require real-world feedback.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；像软件一样每日迭代发布，才能了解用户需求，因为涌现能力需要真实世界反馈。

turley.en: Chat is not the end-all; it's like MS-DOS, and the interface will evolve beyond turn-by-turn chat toward AI rendering its own UI.
turley.zh: 聊天并非终点；它就像 MS-DOS，界面将超越逐轮对话，走向 AI 自渲染 UI。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention, signaling durable value; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，象征持久价值；增长来自减少摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后将带来变革。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like a microscope; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs into sequences are a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化为序列的通才智能体，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video and few-shot prompting echo learning-to-learn; the goal is AI that creates new symbols and knowledge.
nando.zh: 从视频中学习与少样本提示呼应“学会学习”；终极目标是能创造新符号与新知识的 AI。

nando.en: Large models are exciting but not everything; fundamental innovation can come from anywhere, including Africa.
nando.zh: 大模型令人兴奋但并非全部；根本性创新可以来自任何地方，包括非洲。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are now the biggest challenges; safety remains an open problem without solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署如今是最大挑战；安全仍是尚无解决方案的开放问题。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps and has been influential from the start; the main barrier is researchers believing they can apply.
nando.zh: 非洲跨越了历史遗留差距，且从一开始就有影响力；主要障碍是研究者是否相信自己能申请顶尖机构。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs hallucinate due to lack of grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身对为 AI 提供现实基础、减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 产生幻觉是因为缺乏具身经验。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning is best for low-level control, while LLMs handle high-level planning; RL should be a cherry on top.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习最适合低级控制，LLM 负责高级规划；强化学习应是锦上添花。

jimfan.en: The internet is running out of high-quality tokens for pre-training, but embodied worlds provide infinite data.
jimfan.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他持续强调互联网高质量预训练 token 即将耗尽，但具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：数据问题是机器人技术的主要瓶颈；来自模拟和世界模型的合成数据是未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key for robot foundation models; system one remains hardest.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端且能利用多样数据的模型是机器人基础模型的关键；系统一仍是最难的部分。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, and may make fine-tuning obsolete.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题、显著提升智能，甚至可能让微调过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 到 2025 年，他把可验证奖励的强化学习视为与预训练并列的新 Scaling 轴，认为预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

sholto.en: Agent progress is gated by reliability over time horizon, not raw capability; coding leads.
sholto.zh: 同年他反复强调智能体的瓶颈是长时间跨度上的可靠性而非能力本身，并以编程作为 AI 进步的领先指标。

sholto.en: Inference compute will become the major bottleneck by 2028, limiting capable agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他预判到 2028 年推理算力将成为主要瓶颈，限制可用智能体的数量。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and compute now matter more than raw intelligence.
sholto.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为能力已过剩，编排与算力比单纯智能更重要，工作变成管理智能体团队。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth for interoperable design tools.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是互操作设计工具的事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform large squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补空缺的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于大型跨职能团队。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet in the early days.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用它就像早期忽视互联网一样。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更优的小模型可在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：高质量合成数据可使小语言模型强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products must be fast, familiar, and zero-learning, with velocity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，他强调设计师应写代码以建立共情并加快交付；消费产品必须快速、熟悉、零学习成本，速度优先于完美。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity and decisiveness remain the constant: ship fast, iterate, empower designers with ownership rather than structured crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，速度与决断力是贯穿主线：快速发布、迭代，给设计师所有权与自主权，而非结构化评审。

henrymodisett.en: Brand evolves from startup differentiation and recruiting into a strategic weapon that signals quality and attracts top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌从 2024 年的创业差异化与招聘工具，深化为 2026 年的战略武器：传递质量信号并吸引顶尖人才。

henrymodisett.en: Hiring shifts toward diverse archetypes and self-learning interns; gut decisions often beat data in fast-growing startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 到 2026 年，招聘转向多元类型与自驱实习生；在高速成长的创业公司中，直觉决策常胜过数据驱动。

shazeer.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; scaling compute and data yields smarter AI, but internals remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测已具备 AI 完备性；Scaling（规模扩张）算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年初，他转向强调推理时算力扩展是近期重大机会；模型需要万亿级上下文窗口和模块化稀疏架构来实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute alone won't achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in the world are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他深化观点：仅靠测试时算力无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习和在环境中行动至关重要。

shazeer.en: AGI is underhyped; coding enables self-acceleration, and AI can generate novel ideas, not just interpolate.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他进一步认为 AGI（通用人工智能）被低估；编程能自我加速 AI 进展，且 AI 能产生新想法而非仅插值。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict predictable AI progress via compute and data; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为缩放定律通过算力和数据预测 AI 的可预测进步，并预言测试时算力扩展可能很快超越预训练扩展，成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, and natural language won't be primary for programming.
truell.zh: 2024 年他指出智能体虽有前景但尚不十分有用，人机迭代协作仍是核心，且自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality and speed, contrary to initial expectations; every magic moment in Cursor involves one.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的立场从意外转向深化：定制模型对产品质量和速度变得至关重要，与最初预期相反，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都离不开它。

truell.en: Programming will shift from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化观点：编程将从代码转向更高层的意图规范，人类仍掌控方向；品味和逻辑设计比谨慎更重要。

truell.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; the IDE market is much bigger due to AI-enabled value creation.
truell.zh: 2025 年他断言 AI 变革将比互联网更具影响力且需数十年展开；因 AI 创造更多价值，IDE 市场远大于过去。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
abbeel.zh: 机器人需要硬件与软件双重突破；自博弈、模仿学习与微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长程信用分配所需的分层推理。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should guide data generation and augmentation rather than be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency, and pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
abbeel.zh: 先验知识应引导数据生成与增强而非硬编码；无监督学习结合强化学习提升样本效率，预训练语言模型可将通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

abbeel.en: Warehouse robotics demands 99.9% reliability to create real value, and a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 仓储机器人需达到 99.9% 可靠性才能创造真实价值，且单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, and empirical alignment and robustness research is the priority.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，人才缺口大于资金缺口，应优先做对齐与鲁棒性的实证研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability and automated alignment research become the path to alignment.
leike.zh: 到 2023 年，他从泛泛谈安全转向具体路线：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需靠可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than assumed since evaluation is easier than generation, yet uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
leike.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化出一个反共识判断：评估比生成容易，对齐或许没那么难，但“系统究竟有多对齐”的不确定性才是最大风险。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation like SB 1047 are needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他公开批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化、超级对齐团队解散，强调仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），需要第三方测试与 SB 1047 式监管。

leike.en: Empirical measurement and honest acknowledgment of risk run through all years: a doomer is one who believes nothing can be done.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是实证测量与诚实面对风险：他定义“末日论者”是认为无能为力的人，而非承认风险并行动的人。
